scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
There are rumors
going around about
the disappearances of
children in the Morocc
area. Some guilds believe
these are actually kidnappings.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
最近摩洛哥地區流傳著
關於兒童失蹤的傳聞。
有些公會認為，
這實際上是綁架案。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Those poor kids...
If I could do something
to help them, by George,
I would do it in a flash.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
那些可憐的孩子...
天哪，如果能幫上忙，
我絕對會立刻行動。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Excuse me? {0}?
Hi there, I've been waiting for
you to wander past me for such
a long time, you know that?
Novices and Super Novices
are so hard to track down...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
請問？{0}？
嗨，你好，我等你路過這裡
已經很久了，你知道嗎？
尋找初心者和超級初心者
真的很難...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Anyway, I don't know if you
know this, but a lot of kids are missing from Morocc recently.
We're not sure, but we think it's related to the latest assignment
for our Assassin Guild.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
總之，你可能還不知道，
最近摩洛哥有很多孩子失蹤。
雖然不確定，但我們認為
這與刺客公會的最新任務有關。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Anyway, the client for this
assignment needs all the help
he can get. Now, I've heard
about you, and I think that
you could be really helpful to
us in this specific situation.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
總之，這個任務的委託人
需要儘可能多的幫助。
我聽說過你，我認為
你在這個特定情況下
對我們會有很大的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Look, just do me a favor
and do the right thing like
you always do, okay? Here's
a letter of recommendation
to get you started on this
mission, alright?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
聽著，幫個忙，
像往常一樣做正確的事，好嗎？
這是一封推薦信，
幫你開始這個任務，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, {0}!
Great, I knew you'd
show up sooner or later.
Listen, I'm working here
as a representative of the
Swordman Assocation.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，{0}！
太好了，我就知道你
遲早會出現的。
聽著，我作為劍士協會
的代表在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, there's something
big going on, and I think it's
the most important thing the
Swordman Association has ever
been involved in. Pack your bags and head to Morocc right now!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
聽著，有一件大事正在發生，
我認為這是劍士協會
成立以來參與過的
最重要的事情。
收拾好行囊，立刻前往摩洛哥！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All the way to Morocc...?
Why, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一直去摩洛哥...？
為什麼，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I don't know all the details,
but the Assassin Guild is
working on some missing
children's case, and they've
requested help from us and
all the other guilds...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我不清楚所有細節，
但刺客公會正在處理
一起兒童失蹤案，
他們向我們和其他所有公會
請求了援助...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Rogues, Bards, Novices,
Super Novices, Priests...
You name it. This is gonna be
huge. Listen, if you're going
to help, then let me give you this letter of recommendation...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
流氓、詩人、初心者、
超級初心者、牧師...
你能想到的都有。這會是一場
大行動。聽著，如果你打算
幫忙，那就收下這封推薦信...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
{0}...?
I knew you'd show up if
Listen, I have a notice for
you from the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
{0}...？
我就知道你會出現的。
聽著，我有一封來自
普隆德拉騎士團的告示
要給你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For me? That sounds
strange, but would you
please read it to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給我的？這聽起來
很奇怪，但你能
讀給我聽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
''RE: {0}
As leader of the Prontera
Chivalry, I formally request
you to represent the Knights of
Rune-Midgarts in cooperation
with the Assassin Guild.''
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
“主題：{0}
作為普隆德拉騎士團的
首領，我正式請求你
代表盧恩·米德加茲的騎士，
與刺客公會合作。”

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Please assist the Assassin
Guild in any way befitting of
the Knighthood in a special
mission to rescue children
missing from Morocc.
-- Captain Herman''
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
請以符合騎士身份的方式，
協助刺客公會執行一項
特殊任務，營救摩洛哥
失蹤的兒童。
—— 船長 赫爾曼”

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
There, that's all it says.
Here, I think you'll need
this letter of recommendation
if you plan to follow these
orders. I hope you take that
mission for those kids' sake...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
好了，上面就是這麼寫的。
給你，如果你打算執行
這些命令，我想你需要
這封推薦信。我希望你
為了那些孩子接受這個任務...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Excuse me...?
{0}...?
I'm sorry to bother you, but
I've got an urgent communique
for you from Sir Michael Halig
of the Crusaders...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
打擾一下...？
{0}...？
抱歉打擾你，但我有一封
來自十字軍騎士
邁克爾·哈利格的緊急通訊
要給你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They usually don't
send messages. I guess
whatever he has to say
must be really important.
What does it say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們通常不會
發訊息。我想他說的
一定很重要。
上面寫了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Let's see here... Something
about a missing children's case
the Assassin Guild is working on... Ah! The Assassin Guild has
requested help from the Crusaders. So I guess you were recommended.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
讓我看看... 關於刺客公會
正在處理的兒童失蹤案...
啊！刺客公會向十字軍
請求了援助。所以我想你是
被推薦來的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Look, here's the letter of
recommendation that I'm
supposed to give you if you
plan on taking the mission.
For the sake of those missing kids, I really hope that you do.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
聽著，這是推薦信，
如果你打算接受任務，
我應該把它給你。
為了那些失蹤的孩子，
我真的希望你能接受。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Ah, I forgot to tell you
exactly where you need to
go for the mission details!
Let's see... You're supposed
to... Ah, now I remember~
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
啊，我忘了告訴你
具體該去哪裡找任務詳情了！
讓我想想... 你應該去...
啊，我想起來了~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
If you check out the
west side of the Oasis
inside Morocc, you'll find
a very suspicious looking
hut. Your contact from the
Assassin Guild is near there.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
如果你去摩洛克綠洲西側看看，
會發現一間看起來很可疑的小屋。
你在刺客公會的聯絡人就在那附近。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I'm sure you'll find it if
you keep your eyes open.
Anyway, that's all I know.
Why don't you go check it out?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
只要你留心觀察，肯定能找到的。
總之，我就知道這些了。
你不妨去那裡看看？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Right, for this mission,
you'll need to meet with your
contact from the Assassin
Guild near a hut at the west
side of the Oasis inside Morocc. So keep an eye out for him.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
對了，為了這個任務，
你需要去摩洛克綠洲西側小屋附近，
與刺客公會的聯絡人會面。所以請留意他。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I doubt you'll have
trouble finding the guy,
even if all Thieves and
Assassins are starting
to look the same. You
know what I mean, right?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我覺得你找那個人應該不難，
雖然最近盜賊和刺客
看起來都越來越像了。你知道我意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Are you thinking of taking
the mission? That's great!
Now, you need to meet your
contact from the Assassin
Guild outside a hut on the west side of the Oasis inside Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
你打算接受這個任務嗎？太好了！
現在，你需要去摩洛克綠洲西側小屋外，
與刺客公會的聯絡人會面。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I know those directions
aren't very clear, but this
is supposedly a top secret
location that's usually only
known to the Assassins...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我知道這些指示不太明確，
但這據說是個絕密地點，
通常只有刺客們知道...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It looks like you're
working well with the
Assassin Guild. Still,
be careful. There might
be more to this mission
than meets the eye, you know?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
看來你和刺客公會配合得很好。
不過，還是要小心。這個任務
可能沒表面看起來那麼簡單，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It's a nice day, isn't it?
Though, I hope something
exciting happens soon. Peace
is great and all, but I prefer
to have my life shook up
every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
今天天氣真好，不是嗎？
不過，我希望很快能發生點
刺激的事。和平固然好，
但我更喜歡生活偶爾有點波瀾。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Oh, hello there~
Peace be with you,
adventurer. Remember
that no matter how different
people may be, all of us are
united in our humanity.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
哦，你好~
願平安與你同在，冒險者。
請記住，無論人們之間
有多少差異，我們在人性上
都是緊密相連的。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Ah, hello. Would you ask
anyone that you know
to be affiliated with the
Prontera Church to talk to
me? Acolytes, Priests, Monks...
Any of those would be fine.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
啊，你好。你能否請
你認識的、隸屬於普隆德拉
教會的人來找我？服事、牧師、武僧...
任何職位都可以。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
I have something very
important to tell them,
but it's almost impossible
to gather all the clergy
in an emergency situation...
scripts.translation:
[修女]
我有件非常重要的事要告訴他們，
但在緊急情況下，要把所有神職人員
召集起來幾乎是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Oh, {0}!
It must be an act of
divine providence that
we finally meet. Actually,
I have something very
important to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
哦，{0}！
我們終於相遇，
這一定是神意的安排。其實，
我有件非常重要的事想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
You may have heard that
there's been a recent influx
of missing child reports from
Morocc. Apparently, someone
has hired the Assassin Guild
to investigate these cases.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
你可能聽說過，最近摩洛克
接二連三地發生兒童失蹤案。
顯然，有人僱傭了刺客公會
來調查這些案件。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Since this is such a huge
issue, the Assassin Guild has
even gone so far as to request
the Prontera Church for help, so I'd like you to aid the Assassin
Guild in this mission.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
鑑於此事影響重大，刺客公會
甚至向普隆德拉教會請求了援助，
所以我希望你能協助刺客公會
完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
However, I believe that
the Assassin Guild's client
may have other intentions,
so I also want you to keep
an eye out and see if their
client can be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
不過，我認為刺客公會的委託人
可能另有圖謀，
所以我也希望你多加留意，
看看他們的委託人是否值得信任。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Please visit Morocc
as soon as you can.
When you arrive, you
will need the Bishop's
letter of recommendation,
so please take it now.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
請儘快前往摩洛克。
到達後，你需要主教的推薦信，
所以請現在收下它。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Now, for this mission, you
will need to meet your contact
from the Assassin Guild near
a hut on the west side of the
Oasis inside Morocc. I wonder
why they chose that location?
scripts.translation:
[修女]
現在，為了這個任務，
你需要去摩洛克綠洲西側小屋附近，
與刺客公會的聯絡人會面。我很好奇
他們為什麼選在那裡？

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Normally, a representative
of the Prontera Church would
simply visit the Assassin Guild itself. Be careful. The Assassins
must be being extra secret because of extraordinary circumstances...
scripts.translation:
[修女]
通常，普隆德拉教會的代表
會直接去刺客公會本部。請小心。刺客們
一定是因為情況特殊才格外保密...

scripts.text:
[Nun]
It pleases me to see that
you're working well with the
Assassin Guild. They operate
on a different methodology
than the Prontera Church, but
I still greatly respect them.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
很高興看到你和刺客公會
配合得很好。他們的行事風格
與普隆德拉教會不同，
但我依然非常尊敬他們。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Remember that you're
representing the Prontera
Church in this effort, so be
sure to demonstrate your
best for the Assassins, okay?
scripts.translation:
[修女]
記住，你是在代表普隆德拉教會執行這項任務，
所以務必展現出你最好的一面，
給刺客們留下好印象，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Although it is a time
of peace, I can't help
but feel this lingering
anxiety. It's almost as if
some monumental event
is just over the horizon...
scripts.translation:
[修女]
雖然現在是和平時期，
但我心中仍揮之不去一種不安。
彷彿有什麼驚天動地的大事
即將發生...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Oh, {0}!
It must be an act of
divine providence that
we finally meet. Actually,
I have something very
important to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
哦，{0}！
我們終於相遇，
這一定是神意的安排。其實，
我有件非常重要的事想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
You may have heard that
there's been a recent influx
of missing child reports from
Morocc. Apparently, someone
has hired the Assassin Guild
to investigate these cases.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
你可能聽說過，最近摩洛克
接二連三地發生兒童失蹤案。
顯然，有人僱傭了刺客公會
來調查這些案件。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Since this is such a huge
issue, the Assassin Guild has
even gone so far as to request
the Prontera Church for help, so I'd like you to aid the Assassin
Guild in this mission.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
鑑於此事影響重大，刺客公會
甚至向普隆德拉教會請求了援助，
所以我希望你能協助刺客公會
完成這個任務。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
However, I believe that
the Assassin Guild's client
may have other intentions,
so I also want you to keep
an eye out and see if their
client can be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
不過，我認為刺客公會的委託人
可能另有圖謀，
所以我也希望你多加留意，
看看他們的委託人是否值得信任。

scripts.text:
[Nun]
Please visit Morocc
as soon as you can.
When you arrive, you
will need the Bishop's
letter of recommendation,
so please take it now.
scripts.translation:
[修女]
請儘快前往摩洛克。
到達後，你需要主教的推薦信，
所以請現在收下它。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Say, have you heard
what's happening in
Morocc recently? There's
something major going on...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
喂，你最近聽說摩洛克那邊
發生什麼事了嗎？
好像有什麼大事要發生...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Goodness, there's so
many Merchants here.
Wow... Hopefully I can
find who I'm looking for...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
天哪，這裡怎麼有這麼多商人。
哇...希望能找到我要找的人...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DHold it right there!
I've got a proposition
for you, so listen up!^000000
 
...N-no, you're doing it again!
Damn, g-get out of my head!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D站住！
我有個提議要告訴你，
聽好了！^000000
 
...不不不，你又開始了！
該死，快從我腦子裡出去！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DShut up, this is important!^000000
 
No, you shut up, this is
my freaking body! Look,
just gimme a little control!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D閉嘴，這事很重要！^000000
 
你閉嘴，這是我的身體！
拜託，讓我稍微控制一下自己！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I can sense two
different souls within
your body. I don't mind
listening to what you have
to say. But if you both keep
talking, I'll get confused...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...我能感覺到你的身體裡
有兩個不同的靈魂。
我不介意聽聽你們想說什麼。
但如果你們一直吵個不停，
我會搞混的...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Fine, whatever.
 
^71637DAlright, so the Assassin
Guild is looking for outside
help in one of their missions.
Preeeeetty important stuff.^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
好吧，隨便吧。
 
^71637D好了，刺客公會正在尋找外部援助
來協助他們的一項任務。
非常非常重要的事情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildman]
^71637DThey've been hired by some
client to... to... um, you know...^000000
 
...Investigate missing children? 
^71637DYeah, yeah. That.^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D他們受某位委託人的僱傭，去...去...嗯，你知道的...^000000
 
...調查失蹤的兒童？
^71637D對對對，就是那個。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildman]
^71637DAnyway, this is a pretty
big mission, so the Assassin
Guild has been soliciting for
help. I think you'd be perfect
to represent the Soul Linkers,
so I've decided to choose you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D總之，這是一個相當重大的任務，
所以刺客公會正在招募幫手。
我覺得你非常適合代表悟靈士，
所以我決定選你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DSo, go and help the Assassins!^000000
 
Wait, don't forget the
letter of recommendation!
 
^71637DOh, right! Here, take this!^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D所以，去幫助刺客們吧！^000000
 
等等，別忘了推薦信！
 
^71637D啊，對了！給你，拿著！^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Alright, I did what you wanted.
You can leave my body now...
 
^71637DEh, I'll think about it.^000000
 
NOOOOOOO! PLEEEEEASE~!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
好了，我照你說的做了。
你可以離開我的身體了...
 
^71637D呃，我再考慮一下。^000000
 
不要啊啊啊！求求你了~！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Well, if it isn't
{0}. Hey,
would you wait a minute?
I've got a message for you
from the Merchant Guild.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
哎呀，原來是{0}。
嘿，
能請你等一下嗎？
我有一封來自商人公會的
訊息要轉交給你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I'm not sure why, but
the Assassin Guild has
been requesting help from
someone in the Merchant
Guild. Would you go help
them and represent us?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我不太清楚為什麼，
但刺客公會一直在請求
商人公會的人提供援助。
你能去幫幫他們，
代表我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I think they're working for
a client, investigating these
children that are missing
from Morocc. If you want to
help them, you'll need this
letter of recommendation, okay?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我想他們是受委託調查
最近從摩洛克失蹤的兒童。
如果你願意幫助他們，
你需要這封推薦信，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Oh, {0}...!
I'm so glad that I finally
ran into you. I know this is
sudden, but the Blacksmith
Guild has an assignment
for you over in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
哦，{0}...！
真高興終於遇到你了。我知道這很突然，
但鐵匠公會有一項任務
要你在摩洛克執行。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You see, the Assassin Guild
has formally requested for our
help in a mission regarding
children that have been missing
from Morocc recently. Here, take this letter of recommendation...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
你看，刺客公會正式請求我們
協助一項關於摩洛克近期
兒童失蹤的任務。給你，拿著這封推薦信...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
If the Assassin Guild
is asking for help, I have
no doubt that this will be
a very difficult mission.
You should prepare yourself
if you plan to get involved...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
如果刺客公會都在請求援助，
我毫不懷疑這將是一項
非常艱難的任務。
如果你打算參與，
最好做好充分的準備...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, {0}?
I've got a message for
you from the Alchemist
Guild. Well, they're more
like orders than a message.
I'm so lucky to have found you.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，{0}？
我有一封來自鍊金術士公會的
訊息要給你。嗯，與其說是訊息，
不如說是命令。我真幸運能遇到你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
The Assassin Guild has
officially asked our guild
for help in a mission regarding
children that have been missing
from Morocc, and they want us
to send somebody... you!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
刺客公會正式請求我們公會
協助一項關於摩洛克近期
兒童失蹤的任務，他們希望我們
派個人去...就是你！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Or... At least, you're
one of the people that the
Alchemist Guild wants to send
to represent us. So why don't
you go? You know, do it for the
children. Just think about it.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
或者...至少，你是鍊金術士公會想要派去代表我們的人之一。所以為什麼不去呢？你知道的，為了那些孩子。好好考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Here, take this letter of
recommendation with you and
head over to Morocc as soon
as you can. If even the Assassin Guild needs help, I'm sure that
spells really big trouble...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
拿著，帶上這封推薦信，儘快前往摩洛克。如果連刺客公會都需要幫助，那肯定是大麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DGood, you came back! This
guy kept distracting me from
telling you something important. 
 
^000000What are you talking about?
That's your own damn fault!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D很好，你回來了！這傢伙一直讓我分心，沒法告訴你一件重要的事。

^000000你在說什麼？那是你自己的錯！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DYou know the oasis inside
Morocc? To the west of that,
you'll find your contact from
the Assassin Guild.^000000
 
That... that's it?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D你知道摩洛克裡面的綠洲嗎？在綠洲的西邊，你會找到刺客公會那邊的人。

^000000就...就這些？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So now will you leave my
body?! Having to share it
with you is ruining my life!
 
^71637DRight. Okay. So where am
I gonna go, huh? You need me!^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
那你現在能離開我的身體了嗎？和你共用一個身體簡直毀了我的生活！

^71637D好吧。好吧。那我該去哪，嗯？你需要我！^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So you're gonna represent
the Merchants and help out
the Assassin Guild? Great!
You can meet your contact
on the west side of the oasis,
next to a hut, inside Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
所以你要代表商人公會去幫助刺客公會？太好了！你可以在摩洛克綠洲西邊的一個小屋旁見到你的聯絡人。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, good luck and
be careful, okay?
I think something
major is behind the
mission that they
have for you...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，祝你好運，小心點，好嗎？我覺得你們接到的任務背後肯定有什麼大事...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So have you decided to
aid the Assassin Guild on
behalf of the Blacksmiths?
Then please meet your contact
at the west side of the Oasis
inside Morocc. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
所以你決定代表鐵匠公會去幫助刺客公會？那麼請在摩洛克綠洲西邊與你的聯絡人會面。祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Ah, I almost forgot to
tell you that your contact
from the Assassin Guild
will be waiting for you
at the west side of the
Oasis inside Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
啊，我差點忘了告訴你，刺客公會那邊的人會在摩洛克綠洲西邊等你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Please help the
Assassin Guild as
much as you can on
behalf of the Alchemists,
and watch out for trouble...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
請代表鍊金術士公會盡可能多地幫助刺客公會，並小心應對可能的麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
^71637DBe careful in your mission...
There's something major
going on behind all of this,
I just know it. Keep an eye out. 
Yeah, uh, good luck!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D執行任務時要小心...
這一切背後肯定有什麼大事在發生，我敢肯定。保持警惕。
嗯，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So you've been working
well with the Assassins?
That's good news. This is a
great chance for us to show
the strength of Merchants!
Still, be on your guard.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
看來你和刺客們配合得很好？這是好訊息。這是我們展示商人公會實力的絕佳機會！不過，還是要保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I trust that you've been of
great help to the Assassins.
Stay on your guard: it seems
that there may be powerful
influences behind all of this...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我相信你對刺客們幫助很大。保持警惕：這一切背後似乎有強大的勢力在運作...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I'm glad to hear that
you're getting along with
the Assassins. Working 
together, I'm sure that you'll
be able to accomplish the
mission, whatever it may be.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
很高興聽到你和刺客們相處融洽。我相信只要合作，無論任務是什麼，你們都能完成。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, it's you!
I guess that spirit left my
body as soon as you finished
your mission. I thought that
guy was never gonna leave...
Whoever he was in life.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，是你啊！
看來那個精靈在你完成任務後就離開我的身體了。我還以為那傢伙永遠不會走呢...
不管他生前是誰。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
But yeah, if it weren't for
you, that spirit would never
have been appeased, and
I might have been stuck with
him forever! So... thanks, man.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
不過話說回來，如果不是因為你，那個精靈永遠不會安息，我可能就要和他永遠糾纏在一起了！所以...謝謝，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
It's a nice, quiet
day, but the stillness
in the air is unsettling.
It's almost as if... I feel
like something incredible
may happen soon, you know?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
今天天氣不錯，很安靜，但空氣中瀰漫的寂靜讓人不安。感覺...我覺得很快會發生什麼不可思議的事情，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Ah, it's a nice day...
Sometimes, though, I wish
that something big would
happen to break the monotony.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
啊，今天天氣不錯...
不過有時候，我真希望發生點大事來打破這種單調。

Right now, you're carrying

Please come back after

Wait, don't forget the
letter of recommendation!
 
^71637DOh, right! Here, take this!^000000
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
^71637D所以，去幫助刺客們吧！^000000
 
等等，別忘了推薦信！
 
^71637D啊，對了！給你，拿著！^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Alright, I did what you wanted.
You can leave my body now...
 
^71637DEh, I'll think about it.^000000
 
NOOOOOOO! PLEEEEEASE~!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
好了，我照你說的做了。
你可以離開我的身體了...
 
^71637D呃，我再考慮一下。^000000
 
不要啊啊啊！求求你了~！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Well, if it isn't
{0}. Hey,
would you wait a minute?
I've got a message for you
from the Merchant Guild.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
哎呀，原來是{0}。
嘿，
能請你等一下嗎？
我有一封來自商人公會的
訊息要轉交給你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I'm not sure why, but
the Assassin Guild has
been requesting help from
someone in the Merchant
Guild. Would you go help
them and represent us?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我不太清楚為什麼，
但刺客公會一直在請求
商人公會的人提供援助。
你能去幫幫他們，
代表我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I think they're working for
a client, investigating these
children that are missing
from Morocc. If you want to
help them, you'll need this
letter of recommendation, okay?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我想他們是受委託調查
最近從摩洛克失蹤的兒童。
如果你願意幫助他們，
你需要這封推薦信，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Oh, {0}...!
I'm so glad that I finally
ran into you. I know this is
sudden, but the Blacksmith
Guild has an assignment
for you over in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
哦，{0}...！
真高興終於遇到你了。我知道這很突然，
但鐵匠公會有一項任務
要你在摩洛克執行。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You see, the Assassin Guild
has formally requested for our
help in a mission regarding
children that have been missing
from Morocc recently. Here, take this letter of recommendation...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
你看，刺客公會正式請求我們
協助一項關於摩洛克近期
兒童失蹤的任務。給你，拿著這封推薦信...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
If the Assassin Guild
is asking for help, I have
no doubt that this will be
a very difficult mission.
You should prepare yourself
if you plan to get involved...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
如果刺客公會都在請求援助，
我毫不懷疑這將是一項
非常艱難的任務。
如果你打算參與，
最好做好充分的準備...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, {0}?
I've got a message for
you from the Alchemist
Guild. Well, they're more
like orders than a message.
I'm so lucky to have found you.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，{0}？
我有一封來自鍊金術士公會的
訊息要給你。嗯，與其說是訊息，
不如說是命令。我真幸運能遇到你。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
The Assassin Guild has
officially asked our guild
for help in a mission regarding
children that have been missing
from Morocc, and they want us
to send somebody... you!
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
刺客公會正式請求我們公會
協助一項關於摩洛克近期
兒童失蹤的任務，他們希望我們
派個人去...就是你！

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Or... At least, you're
one of the people that the
Alchemist Guild wants to send
to represent us. So why don't
you go? You know, do it for the
children. Just think about it.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
或者...至少，你是鍊金術士公會想要派去代表我們的人之一。所以為什麼不去呢？你知道的，為了那些孩子。好好考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Here, take this letter of
recommendation with you and
head over to Morocc as soon
as you can. If even the Assassin Guild needs help, I'm sure that
spells really big trouble...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
拿著，帶上這封推薦信，儘快前往摩洛克。如果連刺客公會都需要幫助，那肯定是大麻煩...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
Are you headed to the
Geffen Tower Dungeon?
If you run into any magic
users, would please tell
them to come and see me?
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
你是要去吉芬塔地牢嗎？
如果你遇到任何使用魔法的人，請告訴他們來見我。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
It's difficult to gather
the members of the magic
community, and I have an
urgent message for Mages,
Wizards and Sages to hear...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
很難召集魔法社群的成員，我有一條緊急訊息需要傳達給魔法師、巫師和賢者...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
Whoa, would you wait
a minute? Actually, you
might be just right for
this special mission...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
哎呀，請等一下。
其實，你也許正適合
這項特殊任務...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
The Assassin Guild has
sent a formal request to the
Mage and Wizard Guilds, and
the Schweicherbil Academy for
aid in completing a mission
involving missing children...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
刺客公會向魔法師公會、
巫師公會以及施韋希比爾學院
發出了正式請求，
尋求協助完成一項
涉及失蹤兒童的任務...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
{0}...
I'd like you to represent
the magic community by
assisting the Assassins
in this mission. Please take
this letter of recommendation.
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
{0}...
我希望你能代表魔法界，
協助刺客公會完成這項任務。
請收下這封推薦信。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
If you choose to assist
the Assassin Guild on our
behalf, please let me know
so I can tell you where
you can meet your contact.
I shall be waiting here...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
如果你決定代表我們
協助刺客公會，請告訴我，
我會告訴你聯絡人的地點。
我會在這裡等待...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
Have you decided to help
the Assassin Guild? Then
please, head to Morocc and
meet your contact that will
be waiting for you west of
the Oasis inside of the city.
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
你決定協助刺客公會了嗎？
那麼，請前往摩洛克，
在城市內的綠洲西側
與等待你的聯絡人見面。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
The Assassins don't ask
for help very often, so I'm
sure that this must be a very
serious matter. Be careful
and bring pride to the magic
community. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
刺客公會很少請求幫助，
所以這肯定是一件非常
嚴重的事情。請小心行事，
為魔法界爭光。祝你好運...

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
I've heard that the
Assassins are very
impressed with your use
of magic. Cooperate with
them to finish the mission,
and remember to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
我聽說刺客公會對你
運用魔法的能力印象深刻。
請與他們合作完成任務，
並務必注意安全。

scripts.text:
[Academy Staff]
The weather is certainly
pleasant right now, but the
worst storms come when the
winds are at their calmest.
Verily, the peacefulness
in the air disturbs me...
scripts.translation:
[學院職員]
現在的天氣確實不錯，
但最猛烈的風暴往往
出現在風平浪靜之時。
說實話，空氣中瀰漫的
寧靜讓我感到不安...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey little kid...
What are you doing
hanging around here?
You know children like
you have been missing
from this city, right?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，小孩子...
你在這裡閒逛什麼？
你知道最近城裡
有很多像你這樣的
孩子失蹤了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You had better leave
and play someplace safer,
like Prontera or Alberta.
Run along now and stay
away from strangers, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你最好離開這裡，
去普隆德拉或艾爾貝塔
等更安全的地方玩。
快走吧，別和陌生人
搭話，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...............................
Huh? What the hell
do you want? Buzz off
and don't talk to me,
unless you want a fat lip!

[Miya]
Wait! Wait up! You're
a Taekwon Master, right?
Remember Moohyun? He
helped you job change...?
He wrote this letter for you.
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
等等！等等！
你是跆拳大師，對吧？
還記得武鉉嗎？
他幫你更換了職業...
他寫了這封信給你。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Listen, {0}...
He's asking you to help
the Assassin Guild on a
special mission. I think
it's pretty serious business.
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
聽著，{0}...
他請求你協助刺客公會
完成一項特殊任務。
我覺得這挺嚴重的。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
If you're interested in
assisting the Assassins,
then meet with your contact to
the west, somewhere around
here in this city. Well, that's
all he told me, so I'll seeya~
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
如果你有興趣協助刺客，
就在這個城市的西邊
某個地方與聯絡人見面。
嗯，他就告訴了我這些，
那我先走了~

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Hey, {0},
I've got some important
work for you. The Assassin
Guild actually asked the Thief
and Rogue Guilds for help!
Can you believe that?
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
嘿，{0}，
我有件重要的事找你。
刺客公會竟然向盜賊公會
和流氓公會求助了！
你能相信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Anyway, all of us ruffians
are supposed to help out if
we can. Here, take this letter
of recommendation and talk to
Jack, our contact west in this city. You better go right away...
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
總之，我們這些流氓
能幫就儘量幫。拿著，
這是推薦信，去見見我們
在西邊的聯絡人傑克吧。
你最好馬上出發...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
{0}!
The Assassin Guild Master
wants you right away. Do you
know where the secret pub is?
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
{0}！
刺客公會的會長
想立刻見你。
你知道那個秘密酒吧在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, h-hi, Miya,
it's been a while.
What secret pub?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，嗨，米婭，
好久不見。
什麼秘密酒吧？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
I figured you might not
have heard of it. Just talk
to Jack, west of the Oasis
in this city, and he'll let you
in. From now on, you'll be
spending plenty of time there.
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
我想你可能沒聽說過。
去見見綠洲西邊的傑克，
他會讓你進去的。
從現在開始，你會經常
去那裡的。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
That pub is probably the
only place where Assassins
like us can relax. But yeah,
this mission is pretty major.
We'll need all the help that
we can possibly get...
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
那個酒吧大概是唯一
能讓像我們這樣的刺客
放鬆的地方。不過，
這次任務確實很大。
我們需要儘可能多的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
If you're interested in
assisting the Assassins,
then meet with your contact to
the west, somewhere around
here in this city. Well, that's
all he told me, so I'll seeya~
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
如果你有興趣協助刺客，
就在這個城市的西邊
某個地方與聯絡人見面。
嗯，他就告訴了我這些，
那我先走了~

scripts.text:
[Miya]
There's supposed to be
some private pub to the
west of the Oasis in this
city. Ah, you're supposed
to talk to our contact, Jack,
who's right outside of the pub.
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
據說這座城市的綠洲西邊
有一傢俬人酒吧。
啊，你要去見我們的聯絡人傑克，
他就站在酒吧外面。

scripts.text:
[Miya]
Look west of the Oasis
here in Morocc to find Jack,
who will let you go inside the
pub. Our guildmaster will be
waiting for you inside...
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
在摩洛克綠洲的西邊
找到傑克，他會讓你
進入酒吧的。
我們的公會會長會在裡面等你...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
So how's it been going?
I think the assignment you're
working on must be pretty
important. I mean, if it's
giving Kidd and Lin trouble...
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
最近過得怎麼樣？
我想你正在執行的任務
一定很重要。
畢竟，如果連基德和琳
都感到棘手的話...

scripts.text:
[Miya]
How's your current
assignment coming along?
The guildmaster must have
given you something really
weird or almost impossible
to do again, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
你現在的任務進展如何？
公會會長肯定又給你
派了個奇怪或者幾乎
不可能完成的任務，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Miya]
It's been way too
quiet lately. I really
hope that something crazy
happens soon. Otherwise,
I think I'll die of boredom!
scripts.translation:
[米婭]
最近實在太安靜了。
我真希望快點發生
什麼瘋狂的事情。
不然，我覺得我會
無聊死的！

[Jack]
I've been waiting for
you. Erm, why don't you
go inside? Ah, this must
be your first time here.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
我一直在等你。呃，你為什麼不進去呢？啊，這應該是你第一次來這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Hey, you shouldn't worry,
this bar is just for people
like us. Besides, you'll be
coming more often from now
on. Anyway, the Bar Master
is waiting for you inside.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
嘿，別擔心，這家酒吧只接待像我們這樣的人。而且，從現在開始你會經常來的。總之，酒吧老闆在裡面等你。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Hey, it looks like
you've been keeping
busy. Good for you~
Hey, I'll see you around.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
嘿，看來你最近很忙啊。真不錯~
嘿，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Whoa, whoa...
Wait. I dunno if I can
let you in just yet. Ah,
whatever, you're one of
us. If it's just for a drink,
I shouldn't get in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
哇，哇...
等等。我還不確定能不能讓你進去。啊，算了，你是自己人。如果只是來喝一杯，應該不會有麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Oh, hey, you must be the
one I've been waiting for.
Yeah, alright, come on in,
and don't forget to show
the letter of recommendation
to the Bar Master, okay?
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
哦，嘿，你肯定就是我在等的那個人。
是的，好的，請進，別忘了把推薦信給酒吧老闆看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jack]
It's a little weird since
you're not really part of
our guild, but you're allowed
to enter our secret hideaway
from now on. But don't you
dare tell anybody about this!
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
雖然你並不真正屬於我們的公會，但從現在起你可以進入我們的秘密據點了。但你絕對不可以告訴任何人這件事！

scripts.text:
[Jack]

anything to talk to
you about. Move along,
adventurer, and don't
bother me anymore.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Oh, man...
How did you find this
place? This bar is one of
the Assassin Guild's most
closely guarded secrets! Well, the cat's out of the bag...
scripts.translation:
[傑克]

你是怎麼找到這裡的？這家酒吧是刺客公會最嚴守的秘密之一！好吧，秘密已經洩露了...

scripts.text:
[Jack]
But I still can't
let you in. No matter
what. Yeah, my mind's
made up. But if you really
want to go in, maybe you
could, I dunno... distract me.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]

scripts.text: Pay 1,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 支付1,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

*Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaawn*

scripts.text:
[Jack]
What the...?

money at all. I doubt
you can even afford just
one drink at this joint.

什麼...？
這點錢根本不夠看。
我懷疑你連這裡的一杯酒都喝不起。
還是回家喝吧，行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Hmm...
You... You didn't know
what I meant, did you?
Oh well. You better scram.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
嗯...
你...你根本不明白我的意思，對吧？
算了。你最好趕緊滾。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Hey...
You're crowding my
personal space. Step
back before I get violent.
You wouldn't like me when
I'm violent, ya creep.
scripts.translation:
[傑克]
嘿...
你離我太近了，侵犯我的私人空間了。
在我動手之前退後點。
我發火的時候可不好惹，你這怪人。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Whoa, you're not
allowed to be in here.
Hey, master! Do you
know this guy?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
哇，你不允許待在這裡。
嘿，師父！你認識這傢伙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I, um, I'm looking
for somebody named
Marjana? I learned
that she's around
here somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我，嗯，我在找一個叫瑪爾雅娜的人？
我聽說她就在附近某處？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Marjana? How did you
know that? Hey master,
what do I do with this guy?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
瑪爾雅娜？你怎麼知道這個名字的？
嘿，師父，我該怎麼處理這傢伙？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm. I sense no ill intent
from this adventurer. I've
also heard a rumor that the
Prontera Church needs to
investigate poison for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯。我感覺到這位冒險者沒有惡意。
我也聽說普隆德拉教會因為某種原因
需要調查毒藥。

scripts.text:
[Master]
However, there is no
way to tell if this person
has been sent by Prontera
Church. I suppose whether
this person can enter is
really up to you, Litheron.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
然而，沒有辦法確定這個人
是否是普隆德拉教會派來的。
我想，這個人能否進入
完全由你決定，利瑟隆。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hah! Did you hear that?
Alright, how about this?
I'll let you in if you buy me
a drink. Besides, you can't risk making trouble here: this place
is full of deadly Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
哈！你聽到了嗎？
好吧，這樣吧？
如果你請我喝一杯，我就讓你進去。
而且，你不敢在這裡惹事：
這裡到處都是致命的刺客。

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Why should I?!
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Heh, that's what
I'm talking about!
Hey, bartender! Gimme
the usual! I like your
style, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，這才像話！
嘿，調酒師！來老樣子！
我喜歡你的風格，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Alright, you can come
on in. But don't you dare
breathe a word about this
bar to another living soul.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
好吧，你可以進來了。
但你絕對不要對任何活人
透露這家酒吧的事。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Huh...
Oh, you don't even
have enough zeny to
buy water here. Oh boy...
If you really want to enter,
make sure you have the cash!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嗯...
哦，你連買水的Zeny都不夠。天哪...
如果你真的想進來，
確保你帶夠了錢！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Not the savvy type,
are you...? Fine, fine.
If you're not gonna do
me any favors, then why
should I help you? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
看來你不是很機靈啊...？
好吧，好吧。
如果你不打算幫我個忙，
我為什麼要幫你？走開！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Not at all.
Make sure that this
one isn't allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
完全不行。
確保不讓這個人
進入。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
You heard the man.
You better retreat
from this place while
you still have legs...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你聽到師父的話了。
趁你還有腿，
最好趕緊離開這裡...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What's the matter?
Oh, I see... You're
probably wondering why
a Knight like me is in a
secret Assassin's pub.
What about you, huh?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
怎麼了？
哦，我明白了...你大概在想，
像我這樣的騎士為什麼會出現在
刺客的秘密酒吧裡。
你呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What's the matter?
Oh, I see... You're
probably wondering why
a Knight like me is in a
secret Assassin's pub.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
怎麼了？
哦，我明白了...你大概在想，
像我這樣的騎士為什麼會出現在
刺客的秘密酒吧裡。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
It just so happens that
I'm really old friends with
the owner of the pub. I do
favors for him, and he does
favors for me. That's how
we do it around here.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
碰巧我和酒吧老闆
是老朋友。我幫他忙，
他也幫我忙。這就是我們
在這裡的相處方式。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome to my
little pub. What
will you be having?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎來到我的小酒館。
想喝點什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Huh. How did
a ruffian like you
get in here? Well, if
Jack let you in, I guess
you must be alright. So
what do you wanna drink?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯？像你這種粗人是怎麼進來的？
既然傑克讓你進來了，
想必也沒問題吧。
那麼，想喝點什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
This place is supposed
to be Assassins only, but
I guess I'll make an exception
for you. Hell, you must have
had a rough time just getting
in. So what are you drinking?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這裡本來是隻接待刺客的，
不過我就破例一次吧。
天哪，你能進來肯定也不容易。
那麼，想喝點什麼？

scripts.text: Order a Drink
scripts.translation: 點一杯飲料

scripts.text: Ask about Mission
scripts.translation: 詢問任務

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Master]
In this place, I only
serve two drinks. You
want a Tropical Sograt or
a Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這裡只供應兩種飲料。
你要熱帶的蘇克拉特，
還是赤色海灘？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: Do you have anything cheaper?
scripts.translation: 有沒有便宜點的？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, why did you bring
so much stuff with you?
I can't give you anything
to drink if you don't have
the room to carry it around.
Clear out your inventory!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嘿，你帶這麼多東西來幹什麼？
如果你沒有空間攜帶，
我就沒法給你倒飲料了。
清空你的物品欄！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You know...
I was going to charge you
800 zeny for this drink, but
it looks like you can't afford
it right now. Come back when
you have the zeny, alright?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你知道嗎...
這杯飲料本來要收你800 Zeny，
但看來你現在付不起。
等你有錢了再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Most bartenders would
usually charge 1,000 zeny
for this stuff, but I'll only
ask you for 800. Enjoy it,
my friend, and drink it as
deeply as you would life.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
大多數調酒師賣這種酒都要1,000 Zeny，
但我只要800。
好好享受吧，我的朋友，
像品味生命一樣細細品嚐。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, you don't have
the zeny for this drink.
Make sure you come back
with 1,000 zeny if you want
me to fix you something, okay?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嘿，你沒有足夠的Zeny買這杯飲料。
如果你想讓我給你調一杯，
記得帶1,000 Zeny回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
For Assassins, I charge
800 zeny, but for you, I'm
gonna charge 1,000. No
hard feelings, but you're
already lucky to be here.
Hey, enjoy your drink~
scripts.translation:
[師父]
對刺客，我收800 Zeny，
但對你，我要收1,000。
別介意，你能在這裡已經很幸運了。
嘿，好好享受你的飲料~

scripts.text:
[Master]
What are you...?
I just told you
I only serve two
drinks. If you want
water, you oughtta
go someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你要什麼...？
我剛說過，我只供應兩種飲料。
如果你想喝水，
最好去別的地方。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ah, you must be here on
the orders of the guildmaster.
Alright, just go inside. Hey,
but be careful. This won't be
easy like most assignments...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
啊，你是公會會長派來的吧。
好的，進去吧。嘿，
不過要小心。這不像大多數任務那樣簡單...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Mission...?
Come on, what are
you talking about?
Stop talking crazy and
order something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
任務...？
拜託，你在說什麼？
別胡言亂語了，
點杯飲料吧。

scripts.text: Show Letter of Recommendation
scripts.translation: 出示推薦信

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ah, I see you that you
came prepared. Sorry about
that, but we've got protocols
about secrecy that I'm sworn
to upkeep. Alright, do see that
Knight over there? Litheron!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
啊，看來你準備得很充分。
抱歉，
但我有保密的規矩必須遵守。
好的，看到那邊那個騎士了嗎？利瑟隆！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey Litheron! Let this
guy go through, willya?
Yeah, just talk to Litheron,
and he'll show you where to go.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嘿，利瑟隆！
讓這傢伙過去，行嗎？
對，就跟利瑟隆說話，
他會告訴你該去哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, since when did
I become your doorman?!
Eh, ah well. You got it.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，我什麼時候變成你的門衛了？！
呃，算了。你贏了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou forgot to bring your
Letter of Recommendation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你忘記帶推薦信了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright...
You're looking way
too suspicious now.
Maybe I'm wrong, but
I don't like taking chances.
Boys, show this guy the door!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
好吧...
你現在看起來太可疑了。
也許我想多了，
但我討厭冒險。
夥計們，把這個傢伙趕出去！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Just go through the
door behind Litheron.
You know the drill, so
hurry it up, willya?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
就從利瑟隆身後的門進去。
你知道規矩，
快點，行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go through the door
behind Litheron if you
wanna learn more about
your secret mission.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
如果你想了解更多關於你的秘密任務，
就從利瑟隆身後的門進去。

scripts.text:
[Master]
How's your assignment
coming along? Sometimes,
you need to relax and take a
break. When that time comes,
I'll have a drink ready for you.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
任務進展如何？
有時候，你需要放鬆一下，休息一下。
到時候，我會為你準備好一杯酒。

scripts.text:
[Master]
How are you doing
with the mission? It's
good to see you getting
along with the Assasssins.
Anyway, best of luck, pal.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
任務做得怎麼樣？
很高興看到你和刺客們相處融洽。
總之，祝你好運，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hey, thanks for all
of your hard work, pal.
I'll see you around.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嘿，謝謝你這麼辛苦的工作，夥計。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thanks for all of your
help, even if you did go
through a little more trouble
than you should have. Anyway,
you seem alright, so go ahead and come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
謝謝你的幫助，
雖然你確實遇到了比預期更多的麻煩。
總之，你看起來沒事，
想什麼時候回來都可以。

scripts.text:
[Master]
So you haven't been
assigned any missions
from this joint, eh? By the
way, you like this place?
I happen to really love
this little pub of mine.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
所以，你還沒有從這地方接到任何任務，是嗎？
順便問一下，你喜歡這裡嗎？
我真的很喜歡我的小酒館。

scripts.text:
[Master]
If you want, I'll recommend
you to the guildmaster for
a mission. Until then, you've
got to focus on your training.
And until you train... Why
don't you enjoy a drink?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
如果你願意，我會向公會會長推薦你接任務。
在那之前，你必須專注於訓練。
在訓練之前... 為什麼不來喝一杯呢？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Mission...?
Come on, what are
you talking about?
Stop talking crazy and
order something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
任務...？
拜託，你在說什麼？
別胡言亂語了，
點杯飲料吧。

scripts.text:
[Master]
...

[Tao]
Meow, what the hell
happened to you? Kidd
brought you in here, all
beat up and asked me to
take care of you till you woke
up. Are you alright, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
喵，你到底怎麼了？基德把你帶進來，
你渾身是傷，讓我照顧你直到你醒來。
你沒事吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Oh yes, as soon as you
feel better, Kidd wants you
to go to the commanding
officer's room that's over
to the left, meow. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
哦對了，等你感覺好些了，
基德讓你去左邊的軍官室，喵。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Mm...?
What do you
need, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
嗯...？
你需要什麼，喵？

scripts.text: Ask about Mission
scripts.translation: 詢問任務

scripts.text: M-meow?
scripts.translation: 喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The mission...?
Just enter the room
to the left. You can tell
left from right, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
任務...？
直接進左邊的房間就行。
你能分清左右吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Good luck, meow.
Tao keeps this place
safe from people that
don't belong here, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
祝你好運，喵。
陶會保護這裡，不讓不屬於這裡的人進來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Meow, meow.
It's a long story, meow.
Something about wanting
a Big Ribbon and hunting
Wild Roses, meow. It all started when meow, meow, meow, meow...
scripts.translation:
[陶]
喵，喵。
說來話長，喵。
好像是為了想要紅蝶髮帶，
還有狩獵狂暴野貓，喵。
一切開始於喵，喵，喵，喵...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那個地方有魔法保護，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分鐘^000000的時間待在那裡。
別浪費時間，喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Sooo sorry, meow~
Someone else is already
inside. Just come back
again later, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
真...真抱歉，喵~
裡面已經有人了。
請稍後再來，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Wh-who are you?
This is a restricted
area, meow! If you don't
have permission, then get
out of there right meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你...你是誰？
這裡是禁區，喵！
如果沒有許可，
請立刻出去，喵！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't go back to
Lin yet... I still need
to fully investigate
Thanatos Tower...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在還不能回去找琳...
我還需要徹底調查達納托斯塔...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那個地方有魔法保護，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分鐘^000000的時間待在那裡。
別浪費時間，喵！

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

[{0}]
Hey, R! It's me!
Would you please
open the door?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，R！是我！
請幫我開下門好嗎？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I-I'm sorry, but now's
not a good time. Come
back here later, please!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
對...對不起，現在不是時候。
請稍後再來，拜託了！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is a restricted area,
so if you don't have any
permission, then get out
of here, right meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
這裡是禁區，
如果沒有許可，
請立刻出去，喵！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Welcome. Ah, this must be
your first assignment here.
I'm the commanding officer
of these missions, so please
listen to me very closely.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
歡迎。啊，這應該是你第一次執行這裡的任務。
我是這些任務的指揮官，
請仔細聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The Assassin Guild agreed to
perform two missions that are
supposed to be related to the
missing children in Morocc.
You must choose one mission
in which you will participate.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
刺客公會同意執行兩項任務，
這兩項任務應該與莫洛克的失蹤兒童有關。
你必須選擇其中一項任務參與。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Good, good, I've been
waiting for you. Since our
time is limited, I'll be brief.
I'm the commanding officer
for these two missions that the Assassin Guild has agreed to take.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
很好，很好，我一直在等你。
由於時間有限，我就長話短說了。
我是刺客公會同意接下的這兩項任務的指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Due to the nature of these
missions and their objectives,
we have decided to recruit help
from outside. We recognize that
Assassins may not be suited
for some of the objectives...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
鑑於這些任務的性質和目標，
我們決定招募外部援助。
我們承認，刺客可能並不適合某些目標...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The client for the first
mission is the Dandelion
organization. If you accept,
then you will work under Kidd
and both of you will search and
pursue a specified target.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
第一個任務的委託方是蒲公英組織。
如果你接受，
你將在基德的指揮下工作，
你們兩人將搜尋並追捕指定目標。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
The client for the other
mission is an academic that
has identified himself as ''R.'' His credentials check out,
and it seems that all he has
requested special protection.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
另一個任務的委託方是一位自稱“R.”的學者。
他的身份核實無誤，
看起來他只是要求提供特別保護。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I'll be honest: both of our
clients strike me as suspicious, but if working with them brings
us closer to helping those lost
children, we've got to take that chance. I hope you understand.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
說實話：我們的兩個委託方都讓我覺得可疑，
但如果與他們合作能讓我們更接近幫助那些失蹤兒童，
我們就必須抓住這個機會。希望你能理解。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Will you work as a hunter for the Dandelion organization, or will
you work as Mr. R's bodyguard?
Please choose the client whose
job best suits your skills and
abilities before anything else.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你是想作為蒲公英組織的獵人，
還是想作為R.先生的保鏢？
請在其他一切之前，
選擇最適合你技能和能力的委託方。

scripts.text: Dandelion Organization
scripts.translation: 蒲公英組織

scripts.text: Mr. R
scripts.translation: R.先生

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
So you're choosing to
work for the Dandelion
organization? In that case, Kidd is your immediate superior.
I trust the two of you will work well together to finish this.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
所以你選擇為蒲公英組織工作？
在這種情況下，基德是你的直接上級。
我相信你們兩人會合作愉快，完成這項任務。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey there~
I'm Kidd.
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗨~
我是基德。
很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, please take this
written request and meet
the Dandelion representative
in the pub. He'll brief you
further on your mission.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
好的，請拿著這份書面請求，
去酒吧找蒲公英組織的代表。
他會進一步向你簡報任務詳情。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well then, Lin, I will
assign you to bodyguard
duty over Mr. R. Make sure
to keep a close eye on him.
That is all. Dismissed!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
那麼，琳，
我將指派你擔任R.先生的保鏢。
務必時刻密切關注他。
就這樣，解散！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright. Lin will be
your immediate superior
in this mission. You'll be
working with her to ensure
that no harm befalls Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
好的。琳將是
你在這次任務中的直接上級。
你要與她合作，
確保R.先生毫髮無傷。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Heya, I'm Lin.
I'm lookin' forward
to working together
with you. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗨，我是琳。
很期待與你的合作。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Here, take this written
request to Mr. R who will
be waiting in the next room.
This document will prove to
him that you have been assigned
as his personal bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
拿著，把這份書面請求
交給在下一間房間等候的R.先生。
這份檔案將向他證明，
你已被指派為他的貼身保鏢。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
We're running out of
time. Hurry and meet the
Dandelion representative
in the pub so that you can
proceed with the mission.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
時間不多了。
快去酒吧見蒲公英組織的代表，
以便繼續執行任務。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Please meet with the
representative from
Dandelion in the pub as
soon as possible. We can't
afford to waste time when
children's lives are at stake.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
請儘快去酒吧
與蒲公英組織的代表會面。
當孩子們的生命受到威脅時，
我們可沒有時間浪費。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Your first priority is
to speak to Kidd, your
immediate superior in the
mission that you've accepted.
I trust that your work will please the Dandelion organization.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你的首要任務是
與你所接受任務的直接上級基德對話。
我相信你的工作會讓蒲公英組織滿意。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Your first priority is
to speak to Lin, your
immediate superior in the
mission that you've accepted.
Please do your best to protect Mr. R. as his personal bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你的首要任務是
與你所接受任務的直接上級琳對話。
請盡你所能，作為貼身保鏢保護R.先生。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
So how do you feel?
Although this mission
is technically a failure,
we shouldn't feel too bad.
Considering all the unknowns,
we did surprisingly well.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
感覺如何？
雖然這次任務在技術上算是失敗，
但我們不必太難過。
考慮到那麼多未知因素，
我們的表現已經相當不錯了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait; a minute...
Are you saying we stopped
Satan Morocc's revival, but
Raiyan Moore escaped?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等...等一下...
你是說我們阻止了魔王夢羅克的復活，
但萊恩·摩爾逃走了？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah...
That snake managed
to get away in all of
that confusion.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是啊...
那條蛇在那片混亂中
溜走了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Not only did he play
me for a fool, but he
escaped right before
my eyes! Don't bother
chasing him... I'll be
the one who turns him in!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
他不僅把我耍得團團轉，
還在我眼前逃走了！
別去追他...我會親自把他交出去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Lin, I understand how
you must feel, but don't
be so hard on yourself.
Lin, you did your job
perfectly, and there's no
way we could have known...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳，我理解你的感受，
但別太自責了。
琳，你完美地完成了你的工作，
而且我們根本不可能預見到...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Although I agree with Kidd,
I will entrust with the task
of bringing back Raiyan, Lin,
if that's what you really want.
Everyone else must feel very exhausted, so let's take a break.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
雖然我同意基德的話，
但如果你真的這麼想，
我就把追回萊恩的任務交給你，琳。
大家都應該很累了，我們休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
...I'm sorry, Valdes,
but I don't want to lose
Moore's trail. I'd better
go now while I can...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
...對不起，瓦爾德斯，
我不想失去摩爾的蹤跡。
我最好趁現在趕緊去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems upset....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她看起來很沮喪....

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, as a fellow Assassin,
I'm sure you can understand
what's she going through.
We have too much pride to
take this kind of failure lightly.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
嗯，作為同行刺客，
我相信你能理解她的心情。
我們太有自尊了，
無法輕視這種失敗。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, she's an Assassin.
All of us have too much pride
to accept any kind of failure.
It's just... It's just not in
our vocabulary, you see?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
嗯，她是刺客。
我們都有太強的自尊心，
無法接受任何形式的失敗。
只是...只是這個詞
不在我們的詞彙表裡，你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
We failed our original
objective to save those kids,
but we did stop Satan Morocc.
You did a good job, and we'll
notify your guild of your good
work. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
我們未能達成拯救那些孩子的最初目標，
但我們確實阻止了魔王夢羅克。
你做得很好，我們會通知你的公會
表揚你的出色表現。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Regardless of our
original objective,
I must say that you
did a good job. We
didn't save the children,
but we stopped Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
儘管我們最初的
目標未能達成，
但我必須說，
你做得很好。我們
沒能救下那些孩子，
但我們阻止了魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Take care of yourself,
and take pride in the fact
that the Assassin Guild
considers you a valuable
ally. Be safe, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
請保重，
併為此感到自豪：
刺客公會
視你為寶貴的盟友。
一路平安，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd, when you're
ready, I have another
assignment for you in
Prontera. But for now,
I want you to take it easy.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
基德，當你
準備好的時候，
我在普隆德拉
還有另一個任務
交給你。但現在，
我想讓你休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Heh. Alright,
Valdes. I guess
my work is never
finished~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呵。好吧，
瓦爾德斯。看來
我的工作是
做不完的~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
How are you feeling?
I've got some bad news:
All of us, every member of
the Assassin Guild... We
were tricked by Raiyan Moore...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你感覺怎麼樣？
我有個壞訊息：
我們所有人，刺客公會的
每一位成員...我們
都被萊恩·摩爾耍了...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
How are you feeling?
I've got some bad news:
these missions we were
assigned... They were all
part of an elaborate scheme
that all of us fell for...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你感覺怎麼樣？
我有個壞訊息：
我們接到的這些任務...
它們都是
一個精心策劃的陰謀的一部分，
我們都上當了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
We were fooled by that
damned bastard. Everything
that Raiyan Moore wanted us
to do was for the sake of
Satan Morocc's reincarnation.
He almost got away with it...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我們被那個
該死的混蛋騙了。
萊恩·摩爾讓我們
做的一切，都是為了
魔王夢羅克的轉世。
他差點就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
He got away from us
this time... I'm sorry.
I should have caught him,
but he had help. I failed you.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
這次他
逃掉了...對不起。
我應該抓住他的，
但他有人幫忙。我讓你失望了。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Lin, you don't gotta
apologize. There's no
way you could've known.
C'mon, we understand
how you feel, but it's not
your fault at all.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳，你不用
道歉。你不可能
知道那些事。
來吧，我們理解
你的感受，但這完全
不是你的錯。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd is right. We shouldn't
be blaming ourselves or 
each other. For now, we can
be satisfied with preventing
Satan Morocc's revival, and
then focus on Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
基德說得對。我們不應該
責怪自己或
彼此。目前，我們可以
滿足於阻止了
魔王夢羅克的復活，
然後集中精力對付萊恩·摩爾。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Don't worry, Valdes.
I'm going to take care of
Raiyan Moore. He's not going
to get away from me again.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
別擔心，瓦爾德斯。
我會處理
萊恩·摩爾的。他不會再
從我手中逃脫了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, Lin...
Although I'd prefer for
you to rest for now, I can
respect your conviction.
Alright, I'll entrust you with
the task of finding Moore.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
嗯，琳...
雖然我更希望
你現在休息，但我
尊重你的決心。
好吧，我將把
尋找摩爾的任務交給你。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Ah, and before I forget,
let me give you your fee
for taking this mission.
We may have technically
failed our original objective,
but you did very good work.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
啊，在我忘記之前，
讓我支付你
接受這個任務的報酬。
雖然我們在技術上
未能達成最初的目標，
但你做得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Ah, and before I forget,
let me give you your fee
for taking this mission.
I thank you on behalf of
the Assassin Guild for
your efforts and hard work.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
啊，在我忘記之前，
讓我支付你
接受這個任務的報酬。
我謹代表刺客公會
感謝你的努力和辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Technically, we failed to
achieve our original mission
objective, but I will notify your guild and tell them that you were
instrumental in preventing
a worldwide catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
從技術上講，我們未能
達成最初的任務目標，
但我會通知你的公會，
告訴他們你在
阻止全球性災難中
發揮了關鍵作用。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Valdes...
I'm leaving now.
Wish me luck, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
瓦爾德斯...
我現在要走了。
祝我好運，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, then.
You're dismissed.
I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
好的，那麼。
你可以離開了。
下次見。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Alright, then.
You're dismissed.
Once again, thank you
for helping us. You've
been a valuable ally to the
Assassin Guild, so be proud.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
好的，那麼。
你可以離開了。
再次感謝
你的幫助。你一直是
刺客公會寶貴的盟友，
請為此感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Kidd, when you're
ready, I have another
assignment for you in
Prontera. But for now,
I want you to take it easy.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
基德，當你
準備好的時候，
我在普隆德拉
還有另一個任務
交給你。但現在，
我想讓你休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Heh. Alright,
Valdes. I guess
my work is never
finished~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呵。好吧，
瓦爾德斯。看來
我的工作是
做不完的~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You may go ahead
and take a rest. The
last mission you took
was so critical, you
can afford to take
a short vacation.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你可以
去休息一下了。
你接手的最後一個任務
非常關鍵，
你可以
享受一個短暫的假期。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You've been of great
help to the Assassin
Guild. Your aid will
always be welcome here.
If it weren't for you, then
Satan Morocc would have...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你對刺客公會
幫助很大。
這裡永遠歡迎你的援助。
如果不是你，魔王夢羅克就會...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hmm... If you're here
for the reason that I think
you're here, you should talk
to our boss Valdes first.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯...如果你來這裡
是為了我認為的那個原因，
你應該先去找我們的老闆瓦爾德斯。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey. You're working
with Kidd, right? He's
right over there. Anyway,
don't worry, he's pretty
easy to get along with.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿。你是在
和基德一起工作，對吧？
他就在那邊。總之，
別擔心，他很好相處的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
First things first.
We need to talk to our
client, R, over in the next
room. I'll meet you there.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
首先。
我們需要去隔壁房間
見見我們的委託人R。
我在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFLin seems extremely
exhausted and depressed.
For now, let's go talk to Valdes, the commanding officer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳看起來
極度疲憊和沮喪。
現在，讓我們去找指揮官瓦爾德斯談談。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
H-hey...
I hear that
Kidd saved you.
...............................
Sorry, {0}...
I l-let you down...

^3355FFLin seems extremely
exhausted and depressed.
For now, let's go talk to Valdes, the commanding officer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳看起來
極度疲憊和沮喪。
現在，讓我們去找指揮官瓦爾德斯談談。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
I thought we're
only supposed to
protect you? What
exactly is going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼...？
我以為我們
只是負責保護你？
到底發生了什麼事？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I'm sorry, but it is
imperative that I leave
for the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
很抱歉，但我必須
立刻前往朱諾圖書館...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
talking about...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
你們在說什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，這位是{0}，
是我這次任務的搭檔。
別擔心，你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust her.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，這位是{0}，
是我這次任務的搭檔。
別擔心，你可以信任她。

scripts.text:
[R.]
Ah, I see. Please,
for the sake of anonymity,
call me Mr. R. If it will help
you in your task, you may want
to ask Lin to explain everything that I just told her. Excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
啊，我明白了。請，
為了匿名起見，
請叫我R先生。如果這有助於
你們完成任務，你們可以
讓琳解釋一下我剛才告訴她的事情。失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生從項鍊上
取下一個吊墜，
放在額頭上，
然後快速低聲唸了幾句，
接著抬起頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What was that?
Mr. R just took out
that strange pendant
and starting praying
or... something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
那是什麼？
R先生剛拿出
那個奇怪的吊墜，
就開始祈禱
或者...什麼。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I guess he was praying...
Though whatever religion
it is, I've never heard of it.
Anyway, it's not a big deal.
Let me explain our current
objective for this assignment.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想他是在祈禱...
雖然不管是什麼宗教，
我都沒聽說過。總之，
這不是什麼大事。
讓我解釋一下我們這次
任務的目標。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Our client, Mr. R, was attacked
while researching important
documents in the Juno Library.
He escaped with his life, but
he wasn't able to bring all of
the documents along with him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我們的委託人R先生，
在朱諾圖書館研究重要
檔案時遭到了襲擊。
他保住了性命，但
沒能把所有檔案都帶出來。

scripts.text:
[R.]
The information in those
documents is vital for my
research, and may provide
clues to finding those children
that have been missing from
Morocc. Please retrieve them!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
那些檔案中的資訊
對我的研究至關重要，
並且可能提供線索，
找到那些從夢羅克失蹤的
孩子們。請取回它們！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, I guess that's that.
I suppose that if we retrieve
those documents, we'll be one
step closer to finding those
lost kids. So let's do this.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯，我想就是這樣。
我想如果我們取回
那些檔案，我們就會
離找到那些失蹤的孩子
更近一步。所以讓我們開始吧。

scripts.text: Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text: Won't they attack again?
scripts.translation: 他們不會再次襲擊吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait! It's too risky!
What if Mr. R is attacked
again? I mean, isn't that
why we're here? To protect
him from those attackers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！太危險了！
萬一R先生再次遭到襲擊怎麼辦？
我們不是在這裡保護他免受襲擊者傷害的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Good point. I guess
we should split up.
One of us will stay here
to guard Mr. R, and the other
will go to the Juno Library to
find his research documents.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
有道理。我想我們應該分頭行動。
一個人留在這裡保護R先生，
另一個人去朱諾圖書館
尋找他的研究檔案。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Won't they attack
again? Shouldn't both
of us guard Mr. R here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們不會再次襲擊吧？
難道不應該我們兩個都留在這裡保護R先生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I agree with you, but
I think one of us should
be enough to ensure Mr. R's
safety. Besides, we should be
doing all that we can to save
those missing children.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我同意你的看法，
但我覺得我們其中一個人
應該足以確保R先生的安全。
況且，我們應該盡一切可能
去拯救那些失蹤的孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think you're right.
But I think we should
see if that's alright
with Mr. R first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得你說得對。
但我想我們應該先問問
R先生是否同意。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Okay, okay...
So what do you
think about that, Mr. R?
That alright with you?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧，好吧...
那麼，R先生，您覺得怎麼樣？
您同意嗎？

scripts.text:
[R.]
Of course, I'd like my
safety to be guaranteed,
but the information in those
documents is more important
than my life. Do whatever it
takes--please get them back.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
當然，我希望我的安全
能得到保障，
但那些檔案中的資訊
比我的生命更重要。
不惜一切代價——
請把它們取回來。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well then. Mr. R, you'll
stay here where I can protect
you. This place is also shielded
with security magic, so you'll
be just fine. Now, as for you,
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
那麼。R先生，
您就留在這裡，由我來保護您。
這裡也有安全魔法保護，
所以您會很安全。
至於你，
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Your priority is to go
to the Juno Library and
bring Mr. R's documents
back over here. Hey, Mr. R,
how can we tell which are
your documents, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
你的首要任務是去朱諾圖書館，
把R先生的檔案帶回來。
嘿，R先生，
我們怎麼分辨哪些是您的檔案呢？

scripts.text:
[R.]
They're, um...
They're labeled with
the name, ''Moore.''
Just... another pseudonym.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
它們，嗯...
上面標著
“摩爾”的名字。
只是...另一個化名。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Once you're in the
Juno Library, find a
girl named ^4D4DFFYunia^000000. She'll
help make your job a lot
easier. Okay then, good luck~
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
到了朱諾圖書館後，
去找一個叫^4D4DFF尤妮婭^000000的女孩。
她會幫你的忙，
讓事情變得容易得多。
那麼，祝你好運~
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Head over to Juno
Library and speak to
a girl there named Yunia.
If anyone gets in your way,
just dispose of 'em. Punks
deserve whatever you give 'em!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
去朱諾圖書館，
和那裡一個叫尤妮婭的女孩對話。
如果有人擋路，
就把他們解決掉。
那些朽魔
活該受到任何懲罰！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Er, but that's completely
up to you. Just wanted to let
you know that you wouldn't get
in trouble for assassinating when you're working with Assassins
is all I'm saying. Okay, seeya~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
呃，但這完全由你決定。
只是想讓你知道，
當你和刺客一起工作時，
執行刺殺任務不會惹上麻煩。
就這樣，再見~

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, were you able to
find Yunia? Wait a sec,
did you bring the documents?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，你找到尤妮婭了嗎？
等一下，
你帶檔案回來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh oh...
I guess I better
go back and talk
to Yunia once again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕...
看來我最好
再回去和尤妮婭談一次！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yunia gave you the
documents that Mr. R
wanted? Great, now go
bring them to him and
see what he wants us
to do for him next.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
尤妮婭給了你
R先生想要的檔案？
太好了，現在把它們
帶給他，
看看他接下來想讓我們做什麼。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah yes, these are exactly
what I wanted! Thank you so
much for your hard work. Wow,
these are so well organized...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
啊，是的，
這正是我想要的！
非常感謝你的辛勤工作。
哇，
這些整理得真好...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Huh. Now that we brought
him these documents, he's
probably gonna ask us to
do something else for him.
That's how it always works...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯。既然我們把
這些檔案帶給了他，
他大概會讓我們
為他做別的事情。
總是這樣的...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I guess we should do as
Mr. R asks. Go ahead and
check the field west of Morocc
for one of those artifacts or
crests, and I'll remain here
to guard Mr. R, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想我們應該
聽從R先生的要求。
去夢羅克西邊的野外
找找那些神器或紋章，
我會留在這裡
保護R先生，以防萬一。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry that ^A9A9A9WAIT^000000 you've
got to do ^A9A9A9FOR^000000 this ^A9A9A9ME^000000 alone,
^A9A9A9AT^000000 but this situation can't
be ^A9A9A9THE^000000 helped. ^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000

[Lin]
I don't really know
what's going on, but
it looks like we have
no choice but to do as
Mr. R. Moore asks for now...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我不太清楚
到底發生了什麼，
但看起來我們目前
只能先聽從
R. 摩爾先生的要求...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey... I need to talk to
you alone. This R. Moore guy...
I don't like him! Something's
not adding up quite right!
I've been going through his
research notes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿...我需要
和你單獨談談。
那個R. 摩爾...
我不喜歡他！
總覺得哪裡不對勁！
我一直在翻閱他的
研究日誌，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
There's all this mention
of Morocc, Morocc Satan,
and Thanatos Tower... How
is this all connected to the
missing children? If you ask
me, it's pretty morbid stuff.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
裡面提到了
夢羅克、夢羅克撒旦，
還有達納托斯塔...
這和失蹤的兒童
有什麼關係？
在我看來，
這挺不吉利的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, I want you to find out
what you can from our local
historian in Morocc about Morocc Satan and all that. There's
too much we don't know, and
I don't wanna take chances.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，我想讓你去
問問夢羅克當地的
歷史學家，
關於夢羅克撒旦
以及那些事情。
我們知道的太少了，
我不想冒險。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Hm...?
What were you
talking about so
excitedly over there?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
嗯...？
你們剛才在那邊
那麼激動地
在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, we were just
talking about the those
elemental crests and how
they're now taken care of.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，我們只是在
談論那些元素紋章，
以及它們現在
已經處理好了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Say, {0},
were you about to leave?
I had another reques--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
喂，{0}，
你正準備離開嗎？
我還有另一個請求--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sending {0}
on a snack errand and it won't
take too long. Did you want him
to bring you back anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我派{0}
去買點零食，
不會花太長時間。
你要他給你帶點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sending {0}
on a snack errand and it won't
take too long. Did you want her
to bring you back anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我派{0}
去買點零食，
不會花太長時間。
你要她給你帶點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh, yes. On your way
back, would you bring
me a Tropical Sograt?
I'm very fond of those.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
哦，是的。
回來的路上，
能幫我帶一份
熱帶的蘇克拉特嗎？
我很喜歡那個。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, {0},
you heard the ^A9A9A9GO^000000 man.
^A9A9A9TO^000000 Come back ^A9A9A9THE^000000 as soon
as ^A9A9A9HISTORIAN^000000 can, ^A9A9A9NOW^000000 alright?

[Lin]
Back so soon?
Did you forget what
I asked you to do?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
這麼快就回來了？
你忘了我讓你
做什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You were going
on a snack errand,
weren't you?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
你不是去
買零食了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Right. I ^A9A9A9GO^000000 guess ^A9A9A9FIND^000000 you
^A9A9A9THE^000000 came back because you
^A9A9A9HISTORIAN^000000 forgot something. 
Now hurry ^A9A9A9IN^000000 up, we're going to
need ^A9A9A9Morocc^000000 snacks ^A9A9A9NOW^000000 soon.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
沒錯。我^A9A9A9去^000000猜^A9A9A9找^000000你
^A9A9A9那^000000回來是因為你
^A9A9A9歷史學家^000000忘了什麼東西。
現在快點^A9A9A9在^000000，我們需要
^A9A9A9夢羅克^000000的零食^A9A9A9現在^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'm back...

[Lin]
I'm sorry, ^A9A9A9MEET^000000 partner,
but I forgot to ask you to
bring me a snack ^A9A9A9ME^000000 too.
Do you think you ^A9A9A9AT^000000 can
^A9A9A9THE^000000 get me a glass of, um...
^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000 Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，^A9A9A9見^000000夥伴，
我忘了讓你
也給我帶點零食^A9A9A9我^000000。
你覺得你^A9A9A9在^000000能
^A9A9A9那^000000給我弄一杯，嗯...
^A9A9A9樓梯^000000赤色海灘嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Snack? Um... That's
more of a drink, isn't it?
But if that's what you want,
then I'll be back soon.
(^333333This is so cloak and dagger!
How does she talk like that?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
零食？嗯...那
更像是飲料，不是嗎？
但如果你想要，
我很快就回來。
(^333333這也太像諜戰片了！
她怎麼說話像那樣？^000000)

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, good.
You're finally back~
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，太好了。
你終於回來了~

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah! You've finally returned.
I have another request that
I must ask of you that pertains
to the missing children.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
啊！你終於回來了。
我還有一個請求
必須拜託你，
這與失蹤的兒童有關。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, alright.
Depending on what
it is, maybe we'll do it.
But if it's some crazy
nonsense errand, we won't.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
行，可以。
看是什麼事，
也許我們會答應。
但如果是那種
莫名其妙的跑腿任務，
我們就不會做了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
For the sake of my
research, I want you to
investigate Thanatos Tower.
Learn more about its origin
through any means possible. I didn't want to say this, but...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
為了我的研究，
我希望你們去調查達納托斯塔。
通過任何可能的途徑，
瞭解它的起源。
我不想說這些，但是...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I think it's possible that the
missing children were kidnapped
to revive an ancient evil, Satan Morocc. I believe we can learn
more about the kidnappers by
learning about Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我認為失蹤的兒童
可能被綁架，
是為了復活古代邪惡——魔王夢羅克。
我相信通過了解魔王夢羅克，
我們能更多地瞭解綁架者。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know this all sounds
crazy, but please trust me.
Thanatos Tower is somehow
related to Satan Morocc, so
if you could tell me what
you can learn from there...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我知道這聽起來
很瘋狂，但請相信我。
達納托斯塔與魔王夢羅克
有某種聯絡，
所以如果你能告訴我
你在那裡瞭解到的情況...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Thanatos Tower, huh?
Alright, it's not like we don't
believe you, but we need some
time to consider your request
before we can go ahead with the investigation you're asking for...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
達納托斯塔，是嗎？
好吧，我們不是不信你，
但在答應你的調查請求之前，
我們需要時間考慮一下...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright... Before
we go and do this, we
need to make absolutely
sure of a few things.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧... 在
我們去做這件事之前，
我們需要確認
幾件事。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Of course.
What is it that
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
當然。
你想問我什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
First, those men that
attacked you. Are they
trying to revive Satan
Morocc? And those crests...
Were they built to break Satan
Morocc's seal or protect it?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
首先，那些
襲擊你的人。
他們是為了復活魔王夢羅克嗎？
還有那些紋章...
它們是為了打破魔王夢羅克的封印，
還是為了保護它？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh, my attackers. I have no
idea what they could want.
As for the elemental crests,
they were originally built by
a madman to revive Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
哦，我的襲擊者。
我不知道他們想要什麼。
至於元素紋章，
它們最初是由一個
瘋子建造的，
目的是復活魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
However, once that crazed
man's plot was discovered,
the crests were modified to
further shield the seal that
contains Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
然而，當那個
瘋子的陰謀被發現後，
紋章被改造，
以進一步保護
封印魔王夢羅克的封印。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
But as a historian...
These stories about Satan
Morocc and seals are just
conjecture. I need concrete
proof that the threat of
Satan Morocc truly exists.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
但作為一個歷史學家...
關於魔王夢羅克
和封印的故事
只是推測。
我需要確鑿的證據
證明魔王夢羅克的威脅
真實存在。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
If I can obtain that,
people would be able to
take Satan Morocc's threat
more seriously. And Thanatos Tower wouldn't be a tourist area.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
如果我獲得了證據，
人們就會更認真地
對待魔王夢羅克的威脅。
達納托斯塔也不會
只是一個旅遊區。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I'm begging you, please
go to Thanatos Tower and
try to find some sort of solid
historical record that proves
that Satan Morocc really
existed in our world.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我懇求你，
請去達納托斯塔，
試著找到某種
堅實的歷史記錄，
證明魔王夢羅克
真的存在於我們的世界。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm not sure what to
believe, but investigating
Thanatos Tower seems to be
our best course of action now.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我不確定該相信什麼，
但調查達納托斯塔
似乎是我們現在
最好的行動方案。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
While you work on that,
I will be trying to piece
together the information that
we've collected so far, as well
as keep an eye on Mr. R. Moore.
Good luck, and be careful.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
當你去處理這件事時，
我會嘗試整理
我們目前收集到的資訊，
並留意R. 摩爾先生。
祝你好運，小心。

scripts.text:
^3355FFLin seems to be lost
in thought, carefully
weighing your mission's
options. For now, you
better do your part and
investigate Thanatos Tower.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF琳似乎陷入了沉思，
仔細權衡著你任務的
選項。目前，你
最好做好你的部分，
調查達納托斯塔。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
Right now, my life isn't
so important! Please let
me finish my research!
scripts.translation:
[R.]
現在，我的生命
並不那麼重要！
請讓我完成我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
I thought we're
only supposed to
protect you? What
exactly is going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼...？
我以為我們
只是負責保護你？
到底發生了什麼事？

scripts.text:
[R.]
I'm sorry, but it is
imperative that I leave
for the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
很抱歉，但我必須
立刻前往朱諾圖書館...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you guys
talking about...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
你們在說什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，這位是{0}，
是我這次任務的搭檔。
別擔心，你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Ah, this is {0},
my partner for this assignment.
Don't worry, you can trust her.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
啊，這位是{0}，
是我這次任務的搭檔。
別擔心，你可以信任她。

scripts.text:
[R.]
Ah, I see. Please, for
for the sake of anonymity,
call me Mr. R. If it will help
you in your task, you may want
to ask Lin to explain everything that I just told her. Excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
啊，我明白了。
請，為了匿名，
叫我R. 先生。如果這
有助於你的任務，
你可能需要問琳
解釋我剛才告訴她的所有內容。
失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生從項鍊上
取下一個吊墜，
放在額頭上，
然後快速低聲唸了幾句，
接著抬起頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
Your partner should be
able to relate everything
that I've already told her,
as well as any details that
you might need to know for
your job. Please excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
你的搭檔應該
能夠轉述我已經告訴她的所有內容，
以及你可能需要知道的
任何細節。請失陪了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生從項鍊上
取下一個吊墜，
放在額頭上，
然後快速低聲唸了幾句，
接著抬起頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[R.]
The Juno Library is
divided into 3 sections:
2 sections are used to store
books, and the other section
is dedicated for use as a
reading room or study hall.
scripts.translation:
[R.]
朱諾圖書館
分為3個部分：
2個部分用於存放書籍，
另一個部分專門用作
閱覽室或自習室。

scripts.text:
[R.]
You should be able to
find Yunia in that study
hall. Hopefully, by that
time, she'll be finished
organizing my documents...
scripts.translation:
[R.]
你應該能在自習室裡找到尤妮婭。
希望到時候她已經整理完我的檔案了...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
So were you able to find
Yunia and get my research
documents from her? If you've
forgotten, then please go back
to Juno Library and bring them
back here... Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
你找到尤妮婭並拿到我的研究檔案了嗎？
如果你忘了，請回到朱諾圖書館把它們帶回來...
再次感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These are the documents
that I received from Yunia.
Is this what you needed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些是我從尤妮婭那裡拿到的檔案。
這就是您需要的嗎？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah yes, these are exactly
what I wanted! Thank you so
much for your hard work. Wow,
these are so well organized...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
啊，是的，
這正是我想要的！
非常感謝你的辛勤工作。
哇，
這些整理得真好...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright. You need to tell
us how your research is
related to our next job...
We need to protect you, but
we still want to help those
missing children if we can.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好的。你需要告訴我們你的研究與我們的下一個任務有什麼關係...
我們需要保護你，但如果可能的話，我們也想幫助尋找那些失蹤的孩子。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
The information in these
documents is related to my
next request for you. As your
client, I hope you will carry
out this task and consider it
part of your assignment.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
這些檔案中的資訊與我對您的下一個請求有關。
作為您的委託人，我希望您能執行這項任務，並將其視為工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, yeah, you don't
have to remind me. Besides,
we Assassins don't like leaving
any job unfinished. So what do
you need us to do this time?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是是是，不用你提醒。況且，我們刺客不喜歡留下未完成的任務。這次需要我們做什麼？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
There are four crests
hidden in four different
directions around Morocc
which regulate the power
of the Water, Wind, Earth
and Fire elements in the area.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
在莫洛克的四個不同方向隱藏著四個紋章，它們調節著該區域水、風、土、火四種元素的力量。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
The stability of these
elements in Morocc is in
currently in question, so
I want you to ^4D4DFFuse enchanted
stones^000000 to strengthen the power
of these elemental crests.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
莫洛克這些元素的穩定性目前受到質疑，所以我想讓你^4D4DFF使用附魔石^000000來增強這些元素紋章的力量。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Wait... We can honor
requests regarding your
safety, or anything that
will help us find those
missing kids, but we're your
bodyguards, not your servants.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
等等...我們可以接受關於你安全或幫助我們尋找失蹤孩子的請求，但我們是你的保鏢，不是你的僕人。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know, I know...
But whatever force has
been tampering with these
artifacts is probably responsible for kidnapping those children.
It's worth investigating...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我知道，我知道...
但無論是什麼力量在篡改這些神器，很可能就是綁架那些孩子的元兇。
值得調查一下...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Regardless, those men
attacked me because they
did not want me to repair
Morocc's elemental equilibrium.
At least, that's what I believe.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
無論如何，那些人攻擊我，是因為他們不想讓我修復莫洛克的元素平衡。
至少，我是這麼認為的。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You can't possibly
understand now, but
trust me... You don't want
those crests to weaken.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
你現在可能無法理解，但請相信我...
你不希望這些紋章變弱。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Why don't you search West
Morocc first for one of the
elemental artifacts since it
is closer? It should be where
the pyramids are located.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
既然西莫洛克離得更近，為什麼不先在那裡尋找一個元素神器呢？它應該就在金字塔附近。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Please go ahead
and do as he says.
In the meantime, I'll
stay here and make sure
no one attacks Mr. R again.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
請照他說的做吧。
在此期間，我會留在這裡，確保沒人再攻擊R先生。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry that ^A9A9A9WAIT^000000 you've
got to do ^A9A9A9FOR^000000 this ^A9A9A9ME^000000 alone,
^A9A9A9AT^000000 but this situation can't
be ^A9A9A9THE^000000 helped. ^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000

[R. Moore]
You should be able to find
the element regulation device
behind one of the pyramids in
the field west of Morocc. Please
use an enchanted stone to
boost the crest's power.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
你應該能在莫洛克西側田野的某個金字塔後面找到元素調節裝置。請使用附魔石來增強紋章的力量。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
