Alright, now, I don't know
the locations of the other
crests. I wish I had the
chance to search for them
before I was attacked. I'm
sorry I can't be of more help.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
好了，現在，我不知道其他紋章的位置。真希望我在被攻擊前有機會去尋找它們。抱歉我不能提供更多幫助。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I didn't know asking for
protection would require
me to live like a prisoner...
I feel... I feel trapped.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我不知道尋求保護會讓我活得像個囚犯...
我感覺...我感覺被困住了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, what's your problem,
Mr. R?! You're snug as a rug
in here, next to freakin' pub
for goodness sake, while we're
running around doing all of
your dirty work for you!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，R先生，你怎麼了？！你在這裡舒舒服服的，旁邊還有該死的酒吧，而我們在外面到處奔波替你幹髒活！

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
This much is
true, I suppose...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
這倒是事實，我想...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess I'll go out
and try to activate those
other elemental crests
just outside of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我會出去試試啟用莫洛克外面那些其他的元素紋章。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Thank you so much
for all of your hard
work. Future generations
will praise what you have
done. Rest assured...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
非常感謝你們的辛勤工作。
後世將會頌揚你們所做的事。
請放心...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What...?
What did you
say just now?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼...？
你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh nothing...
Just giving {0}
due credit. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
哦，沒什麼...
只是給予{0}應有的讚譽而已。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Good, you've arrived.
Now, to ensure the safety
of all of those poor children,
I need you to complete ano--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
很好，你來了。
現在，為了確保那些可憐孩子們的安全，
我需要你完成另一項任--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Excuse me, I don't mean
to butt in, but I need to
talk to you alone. It's
a very urgent issue that
I need to discuss here
with {0}.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，我不想插嘴，但我需要單獨和你談談。
這是非常緊急的事情，
我必須在這裡和{0}討論。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
...Very well.
Then I shall next;
until you return.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
...好吧。
那麼我先去那邊；
等你回來再說。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Hmmm...?
Weren't you going
out on an errand to
pick up some snacks
and drinks for us?
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
嗯...？
你不是要出去跑腿，
給我們買點零食和飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Oh good, you've
returned. Never mind
the snacks, I want to
talk to you about my
next request if you wo--
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
哦，你回來了。
零食的事先放一邊，
我想和你談談我的下一個請求，如果你願--

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I'm sorry, ^A9A9A9MEET^000000 partner,
but I forgot to ask you to
bring me a snack ^A9A9A9ME^000000 too.
Do you think you ^A9A9A9AT^000000 can
^A9A9A9THE^000000 get me a glass of, um...
^A9A9A9STAIRS^000000 Vermilion on the Beach?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉，^A9A9A9見^000000夥伴，
我忘了讓你
也給我帶點零食^A9A9A9我^000000。
你覺得你^A9A9A9在^000000能
^A9A9A9那^000000給我弄一杯，嗯...
^A9A9A9樓梯^000000赤色海灘嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Snack? Um... That's
more of a drink, isn't it?
But if that's what you want,
then I'll be back soon.
(^333333This is so cloak and dagger!
How does she talk like that?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
零食？嗯...那
更像是飲料，不是嗎？
但如果你想要，
我很快就回來。
(^333333這也太像諜戰片了！
她怎麼說話像那樣？^000000)

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Ah, you've finally returned.
I have another request that
I must ask of you that pertains
to the missing children.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
啊，你終於回來了。
我有一個新的請求必須拜託你，
這與失蹤的孩子們有關。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yeah, alright.
Depending on what
it is, maybe we'll do it.
But if it's some crazy
nonsense errand, we won't.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
行，可以。
看是什麼事，
也許我們會答應。
但如果是那種
莫名其妙的跑腿任務，
我們就不會做了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
For the sake of my
research, I want you to
investigate Thanatos Tower.
Learn more about its origin
through any means possible. I didn't want to say this, but...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
為了我的研究，
我希望你們去調查達納托斯塔。
通過任何可能的途徑，
瞭解它的起源。
我不想說這些，但是...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I think it's possible that the
missing children were kidnapped
to revive an ancient evil, Satan Morocc. I believe we can learn
more about the kidnappers by
learning about Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我認為失蹤的兒童
可能被綁架，
是為了復活古代邪惡——魔王夢羅克。
我相信通過了解魔王夢羅克，
我們能更多地瞭解綁架者。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I know this all sounds
crazy, but please trust me.
Thanatos Tower is somehow
related to Satan Morocc, so
if you could tell me what
you can learn from there...
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我知道這聽起來
很瘋狂，但請相信我。
達納托斯塔與魔王夢羅克
有某種聯絡，
所以如果你能告訴我
你在那裡瞭解到的情況...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Thanatos Tower, huh?
Alright, it's not like we don't
believe you, but we need some
time to consider your request
before we can go ahead with the investigation you're asking for...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
達納托斯塔，是嗎？
好吧，我們不是不信你，
但在答應你的調查請求之前，
我們需要時間考慮一下...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Lin has something to ask
me, so I should probably
answer her questions before
requesting you to do anything.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
琳有些問題要問我，
所以我應該先回答她的問題，
然後再拜託你做事。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
I'm begging you, please
go to Thanatos Tower and
try to find some sort of solid
historical record that proves
that Satan Morocc really
existed in our world.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
我懇求你，
請去達納托斯塔，
試著找到某種
堅實的歷史記錄，
證明魔王夢羅克
真的存在於我們的世界。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
You'll be investigating
Thanatos Tower, then?
Good, good, I'll soon be
able to complete my work.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
你要去調查達納托斯塔，是嗎？
很好，很好，我很快就能完成我的工作。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMr. R pulled out a pendant
from his necklace, placed it
against his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled something
before raising his head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFR先生從項鍊上
取下一個吊墜，
放在額頭上，
然後快速低聲唸了幾句，
接著抬起頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
...
......
Um. Hey.

[Kidd]
Oh hey, you're the one who's
working with Lin, right? We're
all glad you came on board for
that mission. I mean, we can't do everything ourselves, you know?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦嘿，你就是和琳一起工作的那個吧？
大家都很高興你能加入那個任務。我是說，我們不可能什麼都自己幹，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
The representative from
the Dandelion organization
is waiting for us in the hall,
so you better hustle over to
him. Don't worry, I'll meet you
as soon as you get there.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
蒲公英組織的代表正在大廳等我們，
所以你最好快點過去找他。別擔心，你一到達那裡我就去找你。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh, hey...
You're here,
you really came back.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，嘿...
你來了，
你真的回來了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Excuse me...
But can we
talk for a second?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
打擾一下...
我們能談一談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh, hey...
You're here,
you really came back.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，嘿...
你來了，
你真的回來了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Excuse me...
But can we
talk for a second?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
打擾一下...
我們能談一談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something major is going
to happen... You've got to
call the other members of
Dandelion, and I've got to
contact everyone in my guild!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
要發生大事了...你必須召集蒲公英的其他成員，而我必須聯絡公會裡的所有人！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Let me go, I can feel
something happening in
Morocc Castle! We have
to go over there right now!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
放開我，我能感覺到莫洛克城堡里正在發生什麼！我們必須立刻趕過去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Oh good, you're here
just in time. This member
from Dandelion is going to
explain our mission to us.
Now, if you'll give him
your full attention...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
哦，你來得正好。這位蒲公英成員將向我們解釋任務內容。現在，請專心聽他說...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you're the one
working with Kidd on this
mission? I'm your client,
the representative of the
Dandelion Organization.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
啊，原來你就是和基德一起執行這個任務的人？我是你的委託人，蒲公英組織的代表。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
If you don't already know,
we're a public service group
that does great volunteer work.
However, one of our projects,
a child daycare center, was
ruined by a Mr. Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
如果你還不知道的話，我們是一個公共服務團體，從事著偉大的志願工作。然而，我們的一個專案——一家兒童日托中心，被一位名叫雷恩·摩爾的先生破壞了。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
It's horrible what he did:
Raiyan Moore kidnapped all
of the children at our daycare
center! We can't help but feel
responsible, and we're doing
all that we can to find them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
他做的事太可怕了：雷恩·摩爾綁架了我們日托中心的所有孩子！我們不禁感到自責，正在竭盡全力尋找他們...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
However, the people of
our organization don't have
the skills to find him, much
less deal with this dangerous
man. That's why we're asking
for your help in this matter.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
然而，我們組織的人沒有能力找到他，更別提對付這個危險的人物了。這就是為什麼我們請求你在這件事上提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's how the children
have been disappearing?
Hmm. According to Raiyan
Moore's profile, he's more
of an academic or a scholar
than a dangerous kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
原來孩子們就是這樣失蹤的嗎？
嗯。根據雷恩·摩爾的檔案，他更像是一位學者，而不是危險的綁架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Yes, he would appear
innocuous according to
the file we've given you,
but I do not think that
Raiyan Moore is a person
that we should underestimate.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
是的，根據我們給你的檔案，他看起來人畜無害，但我認為雷恩·摩爾不是一個我們可以輕視的人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英組織的代表從襯衫下掏出一個項鍊吊墜，按在額頭上，然後快速低聲唸了幾句咒語。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Kidd? What...
What is he doing
with that pendant?^000000)

[Kidd]
I've seen him do that
a couple of times. I dunno,
I guess he's just praying.
Though, I doubt it's to any
deity or god or whatever
that I'm familiar with...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我見過他做這個動作好幾次了。不知道，我想他只是在祈禱吧。不過，我懷疑他祈禱的物件並不是我所熟悉的任何神靈...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Anyway, back to the task at
hand. All we know is that our
target was last seen checking
out the Morocc ruins. Now, I think that we should begin our search 
by visiting the Juno Library.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好了，回到正題。我們只知道目標最後一次出現在莫洛克廢墟。我想，我們應該先去朱諾圖書館開始我們的搜尋。

scripts.text: Why should we go there?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我們要去那裡？

scripts.text: Right, I understand!
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Our target, Raiyan Moore
is a scholar, an academic.
If he was researching the
Morocc Ruins, there's a good
chance that he went to the
Juno Library beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我們的目標，雷恩·摩爾，是一位學者，一位學術研究者。如果他在研究莫洛克廢墟，那麼他之前很可能去過朱諾圖書館。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
If we're lucky, we might
find some clue as to what
Raiyan Moore is trying to do,
and where he might be now.
Pretty good idea, huh?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
如果運氣好，我們可能會找到一些線索，瞭解雷恩·摩爾想做什麼，以及他現在可能在哪兒。這主意不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I know that Juno is pretty
far, but I think it's the
best lead to follow for now.
It's not an easy journey to
make, so I wanna thank you
for being so understanding.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我知道朱諾挺遠的，但我覺得這是目前最好的線索。旅途並不輕鬆，所以我很感謝你的理解。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Anyway, if we're lucky,
maybe someone there might
be familiar with Raiyan's work
and could point us in the right
direction. Alright then, I'll meet up with you in the Juno Library.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
總之，如果運氣好，也許那裡有人熟悉雷恩的研究，能給我們指個方向。那麼，我會在朱諾圖書館與你匯合。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm...? What are you still
doing here? There's no need
to wait up for me, I'll just catch up with you at the Juno Library.
Besides, I've got a few other
things to take care of first...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...？你還在這裡做什麼？沒必要等我，我會直接在朱諾圖書館追上你的。況且，我還有幾件事要先處理...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey you, Dandelion guy,
you know why these four
directions in Morocc are
so important to Moore?
He wrote something about
it in his research journal.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那個蒲公英的傢伙，你知道為什麼莫洛克的這四個方向對摩爾來說很重要嗎？他在研究日誌裡寫過關於這一點的內容。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hm? No, not really.
In fact, it's even more
baffling. What could be
here in Morocc, and how
can it possibly relate
to the missing children?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
嗯？不，我不太清楚。事實上，這更讓人困惑。莫洛克這裡會有什麼，它又怎麼可能與失蹤的孩子有關呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, well, it's all we
have to go on for now.
Although he's probably
gone by now, we need to
follow through on this lead... If we're lucky, we'll catch Moore.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是啊，目前我們只有這些線索。雖然他現在可能已經走了，但我們必須追查這條線索...如果運氣好，我們就能抓住摩爾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
How should we go
about investigating the
four directions in Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼...
我們該如何著手調查莫洛克的四個方向呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... Why don't we try
this? I'll check the south
part of Morocc for anything
out of the ordinary, while you
check the west part of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...不如這樣？我去莫洛克南部看看有沒有什麼異常，你去莫洛克西部調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Since Moore was performing
historical research, it would
probably be best for you to
investigate the pyramids west
of Morocc. If you happen to find anything, then meet me back here.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
既然摩爾一直在做歷史研究，你去調查莫洛克西部的金字塔應該最合適。如果你發現了什麼，就回來這裡找我。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Good luck to the
two of you. Although
I have no idea what you
might find, I hope that it
will lead you to Raiya Moore...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
祝你們好運。雖然我不知道你們會找到什麼，但我希望它能引導你們找到雷恩·摩爾...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
For now, investigate
the west part of Morocc
where the pyramids are
located. If you find anything
that may interest Moore, come
back and report it to me here.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
總之，先去莫洛克西部的金字塔那裡調查。如果你發現了任何摩爾可能會感興趣的東西，就回來向我彙報。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Ah, you've returned.
I found some sort of
elemental crest over in
the south part of Morocc.
It was full of Earth magic...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
啊，你回來了。
我在莫洛克南部發現了一塊元素紋章。
那裡充滿了土屬性魔法...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? I actually found the
Wind elemental crest west
of Morocc. Do you think this
means that there's elemental
crests in the fields north and
east of Morocc as well?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？我在莫洛克西部找到了風屬性紋章。你覺得莫洛克北部和東部的野外也有元素紋章嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I'm not sure, but I can tell
that there's some serious power
in those elemental crests. Now,
from what we read in Moore's
research, the four directions
in Morocc have to be balanced.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我不確定，但我能感覺到那些元素紋章蘊含著強大的力量。根據摩爾的研究，莫洛克的四個方向必須保持平衡。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hmm. Although your mission
is to find Raiyan Moore and
rescue the missing children,
we cannot allow Moore to cause
more harm. We can't ignore the crests, and should check them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
嗯。雖然你們的任務是找到雷恩·摩爾並救回失蹤的孩子，但我們不能任由摩爾繼續作惡。我們不能忽視這些紋章，必須去檢查它們...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I agree... In fact, the
Earth crest seemed pretty
unstable when I found it.
For now, go and stabilize
all four elemental crests
located just outside of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我同意...事實上，我發現土屬性紋章時，它看起來很不穩定。總之，去穩定莫洛克外圍的四塊元素紋章吧。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
While you're doing that,
I'm going to visit Morocc's
local historian and see what
I can learn about those crests
and Raiyan Moore's intentions.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你去處理那些的時候，我要去拜訪莫洛克當地的歷史學家，看看能不能從那裡瞭解到關於這些紋章和雷恩·摩爾意圖的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... If you want to
stabilize the crests, you'll
probably need to counter the
the element of a crest with the
opposing, superior element,
to balance them out, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...如果你想穩定紋章，大概需要用剋制該紋章屬性的、更高階的元素來平衡它們，我想是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You'll need all four
types of those elemental
stones. Anyway, you already
know where the west crest is.
The south crest is in the lowest part of the field south of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你需要四種元素原石。總之，你已經知道西部紋章的位置了。南部紋章在莫洛克南部野地的最南端。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
As for the north and east
crest locations, you're on
your own. Anyway, don't forget
to bring a Flame Heart, Mystic
Frozen, Great Nature and
Rough Wind with you, okay?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
至於北部和東部紋章的位置，就靠你自己了。總之，別忘了帶上火靈原石、冰靈原石、土靈原石和風靈原石，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Have you been able to
find the other elemental
crests? Don't forget to
stabilize them by using
elemental stones of a
superior, opposing element.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你找到其他的元素紋章了嗎？別忘了用剋制且更高階的元素原石來穩定它們。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Is that what happened?
I can't believe the historian
would do that, Kidd. Did you
explain why you needed to
speak to him, and let him
know that it was urgent?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
是這樣嗎？
真不敢相信歷史學家會那樣做，基德。你有沒有向他解釋你需要和他對話的原因，並讓他知道情況緊急？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hell, yeah...!
Well, you know.
In my usual way...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
當然...！
嗯，你知道的。
用我慣常的方式...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just came back
from stabilizing those
elemental crests. Wait,
did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛從穩定那些元素紋章的地方回來。等等，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm not sure...
Kidd seems very upset
for some reason. I'm
guessing something must
have happened when he
went to visit that historian.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我不太清楚...
基德看起來非常沮喪。我猜他去拜訪那位歷史學家時一定發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright...
So you know how
I was supposed to
visit our historian?
He, um, refused to see me...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好吧...
你知道我本該去拜訪我們的歷史學家吧？
他，嗯，拒絕見我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Why would he do
something like that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...？！
他為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I have no idea!
But I personally think
that he's got something
against Assassins. So
I want you to go and
try talking to him...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我也搞不清楚！
但我個人覺得他好像對刺客有意見。所以我想讓你去和他對話試試...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second.
I'm an Assassin too!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下。
我也是刺客啊！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, but he already
recognizes me. At least
you can go in disguise...
You know, wear one of
those cute hats or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是啊，但他已經認出我了。至少你可以偽裝一下...
你知道的，戴那種可愛的帽子之類的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, alright.
I'll try talking
to him for you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧。
我去幫你和他對話試試...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, alright.
I'll try talking
to him for you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧。
我去幫你和他對話試試...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You should be able to
find our local historian in
the Morocc Inn. If you can, ask
him about the crests around
Morocc and their importance.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你應該能在夢羅克旅館找到我們的歷史學家。如果可以的話，問問他關於夢羅克周圍的紋章及其重要性。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
We need to gather as
many clues as we can
about Raiyan Moore's
research so that we can
better understand his motives.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我們需要儘可能多地收集關於萊恩·摩爾研究的線索，以便更好地理解他的動機。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, you're back.
So were you able to
talk to the historian?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，你回來了。
那你成功和歷史學家對話了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Say, what's that
you're drinking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你在喝什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, this?
It's a Tropical Sograt.
Trust me, it's delicious.
Here, let me buy you a glass.
Master! Let me have another
glass of Tropical Sograt!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
哦，這個？
是熱帶的蘇克拉特。
相信我，很好喝。
來，我請你喝一杯。
師父！再給我來一杯熱帶的蘇克拉特！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright, alright~
Coming right up.
Here you are, enjoy.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
好好好~
馬上就來。
給你，請慢用。
拿著這個。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, drink that later.
Did you figure out why
the historian refused to
see me? Gimme your report~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那個待會兒再喝。
你搞清楚歷史學家為什麼拒絕見我了？給我彙報一下~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright, now tell me.
Were you able to talk
to the historian? Also,
did you figure out why
he didn't wanna talk to me?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好了，現在告訴我。
你成功和歷史學家對話了嗎？還有，
你搞清楚他為什麼不想和我說話了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, that? I never got to
speak to the historian, but
I did talk to his assistant.
It turns out that you scared
him off by brandishing your
blades in front of him...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，那個？我沒能和歷史學家對話，但我和他的助手聊了。
原來是你在他面前揮舞刀刃把他嚇跑了...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You gotta be kidding me!
I'm an Assassin! What am
I supposed to be doing if
not looking cool and totally
hardcore, huh? Damn babies...
So what else did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你在開玩笑吧！
我是刺客！如果不耍酷、不顯得硬核，我還能幹嘛？該死的傢伙...
那你還打聽到什麼了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, those elemental crests
are supposed to protect some
seal beneath Morocc Castle
that keeps this monster, Satan
Morocc, from invading our world. It might be just a legend, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那些元素紋章據說是為了封印夢羅克城堡下方的某個封印，
防止魔王夢羅克入侵我們的世界。這可能只是個傳說，但是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The assistant told me that
Thanatos Tower was actually
a place originally used by
Satan Morocc to summon his
minions. Now, demons or angels
or whatever inhabit that tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
助手告訴我，達納托斯塔原本是魔王夢羅克用來召喚手下魔物的地方。現在，那裡住著惡魔、天使之類的存在。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright...
But what does all
this have to do with
the missing children?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好吧...
但這和失蹤的兒童有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Let's say that
Raiyan Moore's goal is to
revive Satan Morocc, if it
truly exists. It might be
possible to do that by
offering a blood sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 假設萊恩·摩爾的目標是復活魔王夢羅克，如果它真的存在的話。通過獻祭血液可能就能做到。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Then that would mean
that the children were
kidnapped to-- No way!
That's... That's sick!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
那意味著孩子們被綁架是為了... 不可能！
這... 這太變態了！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
You know... I've been
thinking about what we
should do next. If Satan
Morocc really exists, then
that would be a worldwide
catastrophe, right?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你知道嗎...我一直在想
接下來該怎麼辦。如果魔王夢羅克
真的存在，那將是一場
世界性的災難，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
However, we don't really
know if such a powerful
monster really does exist.
I don't want to believe it,
but we gotta investigate the
possibility, find some proof.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
不過，我們並不確定
如此強大的魔物是否真的存在。
我不願意相信，
但我們必須調查這種可能性，
找到一些證據。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
There are those seals
around Morocc, but we're
not sure if they help keep
Satan Morocc sealed, or if
their magic makes it easier for humans to live in that desert.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
夢羅克周圍有一些海豹寶寶，
但我們不確定它們是為了
封印魔王夢羅克，
還是它們的魔法讓人類
更容易在那片沙漠中生存。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah, yeah, I know. Okay,
this is what we'll do. You go
to Thanatos Tower and see if
you can find those kids, Raiyan
Moore, or concrete proof of
Satan Morocc's existence.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯，嗯，我知道。好吧，
這是我們要做的。你去達納托斯塔，
看看能不能找到那些孩子、
萊恩·摩爾，或者魔王夢羅克
存在的實證。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
If you're lucky enough to
encounter Raiyan Moore
while you're there, bring him
back, dead or alive, it doesn't
matter. In the meantime, I'll talk to the historian's assistant...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
如果你運氣好，在那裡
遇到了萊恩·摩爾，把他帶回來，
死活不論。在此期間，
我會去見歷史學家的助手...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
So how's the investigation of
Thanatos Tower coming along?
Did you learn anything about
Raiyan Moore or Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
那麼，達納托斯塔的
調查進展如何？
你有關於萊恩·摩爾
或魔王夢羅克的情報嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: No, not yet...
scripts.translation: 不，還沒...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I found some old log
entries about Satan Morocc.
They pretty much confirm that
Satan Morocc is real, and that
it's sealed under Morocc Castle.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我找到了一些關於
魔王夢羅克的舊日誌。
它們基本上證實了魔王夢羅克
是真實存在的，而且
它被封印在夢羅克城堡下方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Rekenber Corporation
is also responsible for the
tower's reconstruction, and
they ultimately plan to repair
all twelve of its levels.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雷肯貝爾公司也負責
這座塔的修復，
他們最終計劃修復
全部十二層。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
So it's true...
Satan Morocc does exist.
If Raiyan Moore kidnapped
those children, then he must
be planning to sacrifice them
to revive that monster.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
所以是真的...
魔王夢羅克確實存在。
如果萊恩·摩爾綁架了
那些孩子，那他一定
打算獻祭他們來復活那隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I wish we could say that we
were jumping to conclusions,
but Moore's research results
and his behavior... He can't be
planning anything else. This
is the worst case scenario...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我真希望我們是在
妄下結論，
但摩爾的研究成果
和他的行為...他不可能
在謀劃別的事。這是
最壞的情況...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it!
We have to find
Raiyan Moore now!
We're running out of
time! What'll we do?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
該死！
我們必須立刻
找到萊恩·摩爾！
時間不多了！
我們該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hmm... Your investigation
wasn't thorough enough. You
need to find concrete proof about Satan Morocc's existence or Raiyan
Moore's intentions. Hurry back to Thanatos Tower and find it!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嗯...你的調查
不夠徹底。你需要找到
關於魔王夢羅克存在或萊恩·摩爾
意圖的實證。快回達納托斯塔
找到它！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Alright. Come back
as soon as you finish
your investigation. I'm
getting the feeling that we
no longer have the luxury
of time, so please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
好的。調查結束後
儘快回來。我有一種
感覺，我們已經沒有
時間可以浪費了，
請快點！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
We need to calm down...
We're no good to those
kids if we let ourselves
get frustrated. Okay, did
you find any trace of Raiyan
Moore over at Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我們需要冷靜下來...
如果我們讓自己沮喪，
對孩子們毫無幫助。好吧，
你在達納托斯塔找到
萊恩·摩爾的蹤跡了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I've been
asking around, but haven't
been able to get any clue as
to where he can be right now.
How can we possibly find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全沒有。我四處打聽，
但沒能得到任何關於他
現在在哪裡的線索。
我們怎麼可能找到他？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
This is bad... Not only
are the missing children in
danger, but if Raiyan may even
revive Satan Morocc. We cannot
allow that to happen at any cost.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
情況不妙...失蹤的孩子們
處於危險之中，而且如果萊恩
甚至可能復活魔王夢羅克。
無論如何，我們不能
讓那發生。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I know, I've been
searching places where
the children might have
been hidden, but there's
just so many of them. We
really got to think of ou--
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我知道，我一直在
搜尋孩子們可能被藏匿的地方，
但地方太多了。我們
真的得好好想一...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Um? I'm really sorry to
interrupt. I know I'm not
supposed to bother you guys
on assignment, but I overheard
you and wanted to ask about
the guy you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嗯？真的很抱歉
打擾了。我知道我不該
在你們執行任務時打擾，
但我聽到了你們的談話，
想問問你們在找的那個人。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You mean...
Raiyan Moore?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你是說...
萊恩·摩爾？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Yeah. Does he wear
the same uniform as you?
If he does, I think I saw him
here earlier going by the name
of ''Mr. R.'' Also, I think he
might also be Lin's client...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
是的。他穿的制服
和你的一樣嗎？
如果是的話，我想我剛才
在這裡見過他，他自稱
“R先生”。而且，我覺得
他可能也是琳的客戶...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
What, Lin's client?!
Wait, {0}, do you recall
what Lin's assignment was?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
什麼，琳的客戶？！
等等，{0}，你還記得
琳的任務是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Well, um...
scripts.translation: 嗯，那個...

scripts.text: Bodyguard, right?
scripts.translation: 保鏢，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it!
I don't remember
it either! But I've got
a bad feeling about this!
We gotta go talk to our
commanding officer!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
該死！
我也不記得了！但我
有種不好的預感！
我們得去見指揮官！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's right! She's
supposed to be a bodyguard
for someone called ''Mr. R!''
How could we overlook this?!
Damn it, we need to talk to our
commanding officer right now!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
沒錯！她應該是
“R先生”的保鏢！
我們怎麼會忽略這一點？！
該死，我們現在就得
去見指揮官！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, hey...
What's going on?
Was I not supposed to
tell that to you guys?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，嘿...
發生什麼事了？
我不該告訴你們
這些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
No, no...
You were actually
a really great help!
Thanks, Litheron, 
I'll buy you a drink later~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
不，不...
你幫了大忙！
謝謝，利瑟隆，
回頭請你喝一杯~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Now I remember...!
Lin is supposed to work
as a bodyguard for someone
named, ''Mr. R!'' We're looking
for Raiyan Moore--if they're the same person-- then that means--
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我想起來了...！
琳應該是
“R先生”的保鏢。我們在找
萊恩·摩爾——如果是同一個人——
那就意味著——

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hurry, we need to tell
our commanding officer,
Valdes! I'll meet you there
in a flash, so just get over
there as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
快，我們要去告訴
指揮官瓦爾德斯！我馬上
就到，你儘快趕過去！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Raiyan Moore's supposed
to be in the room on the other
side of the commanding officer's room. Check it, quickly! Once
I get my hands on that guy...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
萊恩·摩爾應該在
指揮官房間隔壁的房間裡。
快去查一下！等我抓到
那個人...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something huge is going
on at Morocc Castle. If that's
where Satan Morocc is sealed,
then the demon is beginning
to revive. We gotta stop it before Satan Morocc can enter our world!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
夢羅克城堡正在發生
大事。如果那裡封印著
魔王夢羅克，那麼惡魔
正在甦醒。我們必須在魔王夢羅克
進入我們的世界之前阻止他！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Man, that was close!
We got really lucky.
Yeah... Let's talk about this
some more with Valdes in
the commanding officer's room.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
天哪，好險！
我們運氣真好。
是的...讓我們去指揮官
房間和瓦爾德斯再談談。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I still can't believe it...
Those poor, poor children...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我還是不敢相信...
那些可憐，可憐的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, you're...
You're Lin's partner,
aren't you? Good luck
working with her-- she
can be pretty bossy.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，你是...
你是琳的搭檔，
對吧？祝你們合作愉快——
她可能有點強勢。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it, I feel like
we all failed. I can
understand how Lin feels.
Still, I hate standing by
and waiting around...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
該死，我覺得
我們都失敗了。我能
理解琳的感受。
但我討厭只能站在這裡
等待...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
H-hey...!
Did you feel that?
That eerie vibration
of incredibly dark power...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你...你感覺到了嗎？
那種令人毛骨悚然的
黑暗靈魂之力的震動...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Something major is going
to happen... You've got to
call the other members of
Dandelion, and I've got to
contact everyone in my guild!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
要發生大事了...你必須召集蒲公英的其他成員，而我必須聯絡公會裡的所有人！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Let me go, I can feel
something happening in
Morocc Castle! We have
to go over there right now!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
放開我，我能感覺到莫洛克城堡里正在發生什麼！我們必須立刻趕過去！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Have you ever heard of
the Dandelion organization?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你聽說過
蒲公英組織嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you already know
about us? I feel so ashamed...
We let that Raiyan Moore kidnap
the children that were entrusted to our care. I don't know if we
can ever forgive ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
啊，原來你已經
知道我們了？真讓我慚愧...
我們竟然讓那個萊恩·摩爾
綁架了託付給我們的孩子。我不知道
我們是否還能原諒自己。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You really haven't?
Well, I suppose we're
not a very popular or
glamorous group. Basically,
we're a non-profit organization working to improve public welfare.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你完全不知道？
嗯，我想我們
並不是一個很受歡迎或
光鮮的組織。基本上，
我們是一個致力於改善
公共福利的非營利組織。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
We volunteer to clean the
streets, repair homes for
lower income households, and
even operated a day care center.
However, Raiyan Moore kidnapped all the children under our care...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我們志願清掃街道，為低收入家庭修繕房屋，甚至經營了一所託兒所。
然而，萊恩·摩爾綁架了所有託付給我們照顧的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I can only imagine the
suffering those poor kids
must be going through. I hope
that we can save them soon!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我只能想像那些可憐的孩子正在遭受怎樣的痛苦。希望我們能儘快救出他們！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Ah, so you're the one
working with Kidd on this
mission? I'm your client,
the representative of the
Dandelion Organization.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
啊，原來你就是和基德一起執行這個任務的人？我是你的委託人，蒲公英組織的代表。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
If you don't already know,
we're a public service group
that does great volunteer work.
However, one of our projects,
a child daycare center, was
ruined by a Mr. Raiyan Moore.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
如果你還不知道的話，我們是一個公共服務團體，從事著偉大的志願工作。然而，我們的一個專案——一家兒童日托中心，被一位名叫雷恩·摩爾的先生破壞了。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
It's horrible what he did:
Raiyan Moore kidnapped all
of the children at our daycare
center! We can't help but feel
responsible, and we're doing
all that we can to find them...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
他做的事太可怕了：雷恩·摩爾綁架了我們日托中心的所有孩子！我們不禁感到自責，正在竭盡全力尋找他們...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
However, the people of
our organization don't have
the skills to find him, much
less deal with this dangerous
man. That's why we're asking
for your help in this matter.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
然而，我們組織的人沒有能力找到他，更別提對付這個危險的人物了。這就是為什麼我們請求你在這件事上提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
That's how the children
have been disappearing?
Hmm. According to Raiyan
Moore's profile, he's more
of an academic or a scholar
than a dangerous kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
原來孩子們就是這樣失蹤的嗎？
嗯。根據雷恩·摩爾的檔案，他更像是一位學者，而不是危險的綁架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Yes, he would appear
innocuous according to
the file we've given you,
but I do not think that
Raiyan Moore is a person
that we should underestimate.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
是的，根據我們給你的檔案，他看起來人畜無害，但我認為雷恩·摩爾不是一個我們可以輕視的人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英組織的代表從襯衫下掏出一個項鍊吊墜，按在額頭上，然後快速低聲唸了幾句咒語。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
All we know is that
Raiyan Moore has last
been spotted investigating
the ruins around Morocc.
For now, I suggest that you plan your next action with Kidd.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我們只知道，萊恩·摩爾最後出現在夢羅克附近的廢墟進行調查。
目前，我建議你先和基德商量下一步的行動。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe representative from
the Dandelion Organization
pulled out a necklace pendant
from under his shirt, pressed
it to his forehead, and then
quickly mumbled some words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蒲公英組織的代表從襯衫下掏出一個項鍊吊墜，按在額頭上，然後快速低聲唸了幾句咒語。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Are you leaving now?
I hope that you catch
Raiyan Moore and that
you can rescue those
poor kids. Only a monster
would stoop to kidnapping...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你現在就要走了嗎？
希望你能抓住萊恩·摩爾，
救出那些可憐的孩子。只有魔物才會做出綁架這種卑鄙行徑...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
So you found some
sort of clue as to where
Raiyan would be? I agree
that it sounds like a long
shot, but we've got to try
everything that we can!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
看來你找到了一些關於萊恩·摩爾下落的線索？
雖然聽起來希望渺茫，但我們必須嘗試一切可能的方法！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan seems to have
been conducting some very
peculiar research. What could
the meaning of ''Morocc's four
directions'' be? How can it
possibly be of significance?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
萊恩·摩爾似乎在進行一些非常古怪的研究。
“夢羅克的四個方位”是什麼意思？
這怎麼可能有什麼意義呢？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
So you're really going to
check the four directions
in Morocc... What could
possibly interest Raiyan
Moore in Morocc? Perhaps
he is not just a kidnapper...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
所以你真的要去檢查夢羅克的四個方位...
萊恩·摩爾對夢羅克有什麼興趣？
也許他不僅僅是一個綁架犯...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
You found a crest shaped
like the Wind? Ah, Kidd
mentioned that he found an
elemental crest imbued with
the power of Earth. You should
share your findings with him...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
你找到了一個風之形狀的紋章？啊，基德說他找到了一個蘊含大地之力的元素紋章。你應該把你的發現分享給他...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I don't understand what
could be so important about
these elemental crest devices
hidden in Morocc. What could
Raiyan Moore be planning...?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我不明白為什麼這些隱藏在夢羅克的元素紋章裝置如此重要。萊恩·摩爾到底在謀劃什麼...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Is that what happened?
I can't believe the historian
would do that, Kidd. Did you
explain why you needed to
speak to him, and let him
know that it was urgent?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
是這樣嗎？
真不敢相信歷史學家會那樣做，基德。你有沒有向他解釋你需要和他對話的原因，並讓他知道情況緊急？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hell, yeah...!
Well, you know.
In my usual way...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
當然...！
嗯，你知道的。
用我慣常的方式...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just came back
from stabilizing those
elemental crests. Wait,
did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛從穩定那些元素紋章的地方回來。等等，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm not sure...
Kidd seems very upset
for some reason. I'm
guessing something must
have happened when he
went to visit that historian.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我不太清楚...
基德看起來非常沮喪。我猜他去拜訪那位歷史學家時一定發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Now why would Morocc's
local historian refuse to see
Kidd? Maybe he didn't fully
understand the importance
of this mission? How strange...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
夢羅克當地的歷史學家為什麼拒絕見基德？也許他沒有完全理解這次任務的重要性？真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
We have so very few leads
to finding Raiyan Moore, it's
completely frustrating. I know
that we have no choice, but
I'm worried to death about
those kidnapped children...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我們要找到萊恩·摩爾的線索太少了，真是令人沮喪。我知道我們別無選擇，但我對那些被綁架的孩子非常擔憂...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Try not to worry
so much. We'll just
do what we always do:
everything we can. I only
hope it'll be enough this time.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
別太擔心了。
我們會像往常一樣：
盡我們所能。我只希望這次能成功。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, you've returned?
Were you able to talk to
the historian? Heh, while you
were gone, I've been helping
myself to some of these drinks~
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
哦，你回來了？
你見到歷史學家了嗎？呵呵，趁你不在的時候，我喝了一些這些飲料~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Say, what's that
you're drinking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你在喝什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Oh, this?
It's a Tropical Sograt.
Trust me, it's delicious.
Here, let me buy you a glass.
Master! Let me have another
glass of Tropical Sograt!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
哦，這個？
是熱帶的蘇克拉特。
相信我，很好喝。
來，我請你喝一杯。
師父！再給我來一杯熱帶的蘇克拉特！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Alright, alright~
Coming right up.
Here you are, enjoy.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
好好好~
馬上就來。
給你，請慢用。
拿著這個。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Hey, drink that later.
Did you figure out why
the historian refused to
see me? Gimme your report~
scripts.translation:
[基德]
嘿，那個待會兒再喝。
你搞清楚歷史學家為什麼拒絕見我了？給我彙報一下~

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Isn't Tropical Sograt
so good? I can't believe
Assassins can enjoy this
drink whenever they want~
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
熱帶的蘇克拉特真好喝啊！真不敢相信刺客們想喝就能喝~

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Don't forget that
we've got a mission
to finish! Come on,
gimme your report now.
What'd you learn exactly?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
別忘了我們還有任務要完成！
快點，現在彙報一下。
你具體查到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan Moore...
The missing children...
Satan Morocc and Thanatos
Tower. They couldn't all be
connected somehow, can they?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
萊恩·摩爾...
失蹤的孩子...
魔王夢羅克和達納托斯塔。它們之間不可能有什麼聯絡吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I hope that you'll be
able to find Raiyan Moore
at Thanatos Tower. Though,
it's a public place, so I don't
think he'd linger there for
too long. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
希望你能找到萊恩·摩爾在達納托斯塔。不過，
那裡是個公共場所，我想他不會在那裡逗留太久。祝你好運...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
That monster...
So he kidnapped the
children to-- to sacrifice
them?! That's... unthinkable.
All to bring back some dead
demon? Why would he do that?!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
那個魔物...
他綁架孩子是為了——為了犧牲他們？！這...簡直不可思議。
只是為了復活某個死去的惡魔？他為什麼要這麼做？！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Raiyan Moore kidnapped
the children to revive Satan
Morocc, and had the nerve
to hire the Assassin Guild
to protect him?! He's truly
a devious mastermind...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
萊恩·摩爾綁架孩子是為了復活魔王夢羅克，竟然還有臉僱傭刺客公會來保護他？！他真是個狡猾的陰謀家...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Being duped by that guy...
I've never been so insulted!
It's decided: that Raiyan
Moore doesn't deserve
to take another breath.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
被那個傢伙騙了...
我從未如此受辱！
決定了：那個萊恩·摩爾不配再呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I can't believe that
Raiyan Moore was under
our noses this whole time...
Do you know where he is now?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
真不敢相信，萊恩·摩爾竟然一直就在我們身邊...
你知道他現在在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yeah. Yeah...
Don't get too
worked up, he'll
be right here soon.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
知道。知道...
別太激動，他很快就會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
This is bad news...
It looks like Raiyan Moore
is performing the ritual to
revive Satan Morocc. We need
to go to Morocc Castle, where
Satan Morocc is sealed...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
這是壞訊息...
看起來萊恩·摩爾正在舉行復活魔王夢羅克的儀式。我們需要去夢羅克城堡，那裡封印著魔王夢羅克...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Well, we've sent some
people to purse Raiyan,
though I honestly doubt
that they'll be able to get
him. Luckily, though, you
seem to be alright...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
嗯，我們已經派人去追捕萊恩了，
不過說實話，我不認為他們能抓到他。幸運的是，
你似乎沒事...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm sorry...
But I'm far too busy
to speak with you now.
This matter requires
my full attention!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
抱歉...
但我現在太忙了，
沒時間和你對話。
這件事需要我全神貫注！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Those poor children...
And what are we going
to tell their parents?
Still, perhaps this is
the will of ^4D4DFFFreya^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
那些可憐的孩子...
我們要怎麼告訴他們的父母？
不過，也許這正是^4D4DFF芙蕾雅^000000的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Their deaths may have
been horrific, but I believe
that those children are now
safe in Freya's loving arms.
Who can understand the 
divine will of Freya?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
他們的死可能很慘烈，但我相信
那些孩子現在正安然地躺在芙蕾雅慈愛的懷抱中。
誰能理解芙蕾雅的神聖旨意呢？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Freya...?
I thought most
people around here
prayed to Odin. Well,
I suppose that explains
a couple things.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
芙蕾雅...？
我以為這裡大多數人
都崇拜奧丁。好吧，
這就解釋了一些事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but may I ask
you a question? I'm hoping
that you might be able to
help me with something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，我可以問你個問題嗎？我希望
你能幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Eh? Oh, I'm sorry, I was
so busy reading this book!
So, uh, what exactly did
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
啊？哦，對不起，我剛才
太專心看這本書了！
那麼，呃，你具體想問什麼？

scripts.text: Do you know Raiyan Moore?
scripts.translation: 你認識萊恩·摩爾嗎？

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什麼書？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Raiyan Moore?
I don't know any--
Oh, you must mean
Mr. R. Moore. Yes,
I suppose I do if his
first name is Raiyan.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
萊恩·摩爾？
我不認識什麼——
哦，你一定是說
R. 摩爾先生。是的，
如果他的名字是萊恩的話，
我想我確實認識他。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I'm Yunia, Mr. Moore's
temporary assistant while
he's working on his current
research project. I can't make
heads or tails out of whatever
he's been studying, though...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
我是尤妮婭，是R. 摩爾先生
在研究當前專案期間的臨時助手。我完全搞不懂
他在研究什麼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great, when was the
last time you've seen
him? You see, we're
actually looking for him...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了，你最後一次見到他是什麼時候？你看，我們
其實正在找他...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I actually saw him here
everyday in the library up
until a couple days ago. That's
when these strange men tried
to capture him, but luckily he
was able to escape.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
實際上，直到幾天前，我每天都在圖書館見到他。就在那時，
那些奇怪的男人們試圖抓他，但幸運的是他
逃掉了。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I remember that things
were so crazy that day,
and Mr. Moore even forgot
to bring his documents with
him while he was running away.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
我記得那天非常混亂，
而且摩爾先生逃跑時甚至忘了帶他的檔案。

scripts.text: Documents?
scripts.translation: 檔案？

scripts.text: Where did he go?
scripts.translation: 他去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Yes, he was perusing
some historic documents
before he ran off. They're
all about history, so I couldn't really understand them at all...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
是的，他在逃跑前正在翻閱
一些歷史檔案。它們都是關於歷史的，所以我完全看不懂...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mm... I really don't
know? But I did keep and
organize the documents that
he was researching so that
they'll be ready when he
comes back to the library.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
嗯...我真的不知道。不過我把他研究的那些檔案都整理好了，等他回到圖書館就能直接用。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... you know.
It's just this novel
About a boy who becomes.
a slave and he needs to
pay off his parents' debts.
But then, he falls in love...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
哦...你知道的。
就是那本小說，
講一個男孩變成奴隸，
需要償還父母的債務。
然後，他墜入了愛河...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
And the girl he falls
in love with? He doesn't
know it yet, but she's the
dark overlord of darkness!
At least, I think she is. They
keep hinting at it, though.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
而他愛上那個女孩？
他還沒發現，
但她其實是黑暗勢力的統治者！
至少我是這麼覺得的，
雖然劇情一直在暗示這一點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was wondering if
I could look through
that Mr. Moore was studying...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在想能不能看看
摩爾先生研究的那些檔案...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Well, I gave most of the
documents that I organized
to someone else already, but
now that I think about it, there are a few leftover, unorganized
files that you can check out.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
嗯，我整理的大部分檔案
已經交給別人了，
不過現在想想，
還有幾份沒整理的檔案，
你可以看看。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Actually, the person that took
the organized documents did
so on Mr. Moore's behalf. Then,
she quickly vanished before
I could ask her for her name or Mr. Moore's contact information.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
其實，拿走那些整理好的檔案的人
是受摩爾先生委託的。
然後，
她在我問出她的名字
或摩爾先生的聯絡方式之前
就迅速消失了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn! That information
would have been really
helpful! (^333333I better not let
her know that I'm actually
trying to hunt Raiyan Moore^FFFFFF ^333333 down, or that he's a kidnapper.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死！那些資訊
本來會很有用的！
(^333333我最好別讓她知道
我其實是在追捕
R. 摩爾，^FFFFFF ^333333或者知道他是綁匪。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
I hope Mr. Moore is
alright. Oh, why don't
you try reading his notes
and his journal on his desk?
That might be really helpful.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
希望摩爾先生沒事。
哦，你不妨讀讀他桌上
的筆記和日記，
那可能會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mr. Moore's desk?
Just go upstairs and
look for it in the corner.
You should be able to
easily find his notes and
journal right on top of it.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
摩爾先生的桌子？
直接上樓，
在角落裡找找。
你應該能很容易地
在桌上找到他的筆記
和日記。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but I'm
looking for a Ms. Yunia?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
我在找尤妮婭小姐？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh, that's me!
So how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
哦，就是我！
那麼，有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Mr. R's Documents
scripts.translation: R. 摩爾的檔案

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什麼書？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Mr. R? Ohhhh...
Mr. R. Moore. Is...
Is he alright? I was
so scared when those
strange men attacked him
right here in Juno Library!
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
R. 先生？哦...
R. 摩爾。他...
他沒事吧？
當那些奇怪的男人在
朱諾圖書館襲擊他時，
我嚇壞了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, he's perfectly safe.
We've got a professional to
ensure nothing happens to him.
But yes, he wanted me to come
here to pick up some research documents. Do you know about that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，他非常安全。
我們有專業人士
確保他萬無一失。
不過是的，他讓我來
這裡取一些研究檔案。
你知道這件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Ah, yes, I do!
I've been organizing
them for his return.
Would you like to take
a look before delivering
them to Mr. R. Moore?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
啊，是的，我知道！
我一直在為他的歸來
整理這些檔案。
在交給 R. 摩爾之前，
你想先看看嗎？

scripts.text: May I?
scripts.translation: 可以嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks...
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Heh heh~ Alright~
First you should make sure
that the documents you're
delivering are the ones
that he needs, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
嘿嘿~ 好吧~
首先，你應該確認
你要交付的檔案
是他需要的那些，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... You know. Just this
story about this guy who's
cursed so that he transforms
into a fat dork around beautiful girls, and into a svelte, handsome
man around dorky women.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
哦...你知道的。
就是那個故事，
講一個被詛咒的傢伙，
在漂亮女孩面前會變成
一個肥胖的笨蛋，
而在笨蛋女人面前
會變成帥氣苗條的男人。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
So then he gets into this
crazy love triangle, and now
I'm at the part when he has to
go on a date with both a gorgeous girl AND a geeky girl. How's
he going to transform next...?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
然後他陷入了
一段瘋狂的三角戀，
現在劇情到了他必須
同時和一個漂亮女孩
和一個書呆子女孩約會。
他接下來要怎麼變...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Okay, these should
be the documents that
Mr. Moore wants to read.
Just read through them
quickly to make sure that
I gave you the right ones.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
好的，這些應該
就是摩爾先生
想要閱讀的檔案。
請快速瀏覽一遍，
確認我給你的
是正確的那些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see here...
Some of these sentences
are underlined... Ah, and here
are some notes in the margins.
Maybe this'll tell me about
Mr. R. Moore's research...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我看看...
有些句子被劃了線...
啊，這裡還有一些
頁邊筆記。
也許這能告訴我
R. 摩爾先生的研究內容...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffSatan Morocc appeared,
turning the world into a
living hell. Somehow, the
monster was sealed, and a
castle and town was built over^FFFFFF ^4d4dff its prison. This place is Morocc.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff魔王夢羅克出現了，
將世界變成了
人間地獄。不知怎的，
魔物被封印了，
一座城堡和城鎮
建在它的監獄之上^FFFFFF ^4d4dff。這個地方就是夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, that's actually
pretty interesting. But
I need to do my job first.
Perhaps I'll ask Mr. R. Moore
about this later. Hey, Yunia,
thanks for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，這其實
挺有趣的。但我
得先做我的工作。
也許之後我會
問問R. 摩爾先生
關於這件事。嘿，尤妮婭，
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
You're welcome~
Oh, and please give
my regards to Mr. Moore
when you see him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
不客氣~
哦，還有，見到摩爾先生
時請代我問候他，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
But what are
you reading?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下...
但你在讀
什麼書？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh... You know.
This story about this girl
who becomes a princess.
And then she owns this harem
of handsome boys, see? But
then, she meets this one boy...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
哦...你知道的。
就是那個故事，
講一個女孩
變成了公主。
然後她擁有了
一群帥哥後宮，懂嗎？
但後來，她遇到了
一個男孩...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
This boy refuses to join
her harem, and it's, like, so
ironic because he's the one she
really wants. Even though any
other boy in the world would
join her harem ^FF0000willingly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
這個男孩拒絕加入
她的後宮，這真是
太諷刺了，因為他
才是她真正想要的。
儘管世界上
其他任何男孩
都會^FF0000心甘情願^000000地加入她的後宮。

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Anyway, I'm reading the part
where he-- his name's Extopher-- has to defeat Count Guillermo
in a sword duel for the right
to ride the unicorn pegasus.
Ooh, what'll happen next?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
總之，我正在讀
他——他叫Extopher——
必須與Guillermo伯爵
進行劍術決鬥，
以贏得騎乘
獨角獸飛馬的權利。
噢，接下來會發生什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a crumpled piece
of paper filled with scribbles.
Apparently, this was ripped
from Moore's journal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一張
皺巴巴的紙，
上面寫滿了塗鴉。
顯然，這是從
摩爾的日記本上
撕下來的。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nuts...
I came all the
way to Juno to look
through some trash?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死...
我大老遠
跑到朱諾，
就是為了看
一堆垃圾？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
For the sake of those
missing kids, we're duty
bound to sift through every
piece of possible evidence,
not matter how useless it may
look! Don't throw it away yet!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
為了那些
失蹤的孩子，
我們有責任
仔細檢查每一片
可能的證據，
無論它看起來
多麼沒用！
先別把它扔掉！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Holy--!
You just came
out of nowhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪--!
你剛才
是從哪裡冒出來的！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Sorry. I did tell
you I'd meet you here
in Juno. Anyway, let's
both take a careful look at
this paper from Moore's desk.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
抱歉。我確實
告訴過你
我會在朱諾
和你見面。
總之，讓我們
一起仔細看看
這張來自摩爾
書桌的紙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Morocc...
Were summoned...
Through the tower...?
This handwriting is so
bad, it's barely legible.
Can you read any of this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...夢羅克...
被召喚了...
通過中央塔...？
這字跡太潦草了，
幾乎無法辨認。
你能讀出
其中任何內容嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Uhhh... Tower...
Prontera... Impact created...
Desert? Must... four directions
in Morocc... Oh! Balance the
four directions in Morocc
to prevent a great evil.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
呃...中央塔...
普隆德拉...衝擊產生了...
沙漠？必須...夢羅克的
四個方向...噢！平衡
夢羅克的四個方向，
以防止巨大的邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Sorry, that's all I can read, but it must be important: if Moore
spent the time to write that
part clearly, then he must be
planning to investigate the
four directions in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
抱歉，我只能讀出這些，但這一定很重要：如果摩爾
花了時間
把這部分寫得
很清楚，那麼他一定
打算調查
夢羅克的四個方向。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
I'm not sure what it
could all mean, but I'm
gonna bring this part of
his journal with me. I'll
meet you back in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德]
我不確定
這一切意味著什麼，
但我會把
他日記本的這部分
帶在身上。
我會在夢羅克
和你見面。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a journal filled
with illegible scribbles.
It's impossible for you to
decipher the writing inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一本
寫滿無法辨認
塗鴉的日記本。
你無法破譯
裡面的文字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a journal that is
missing many of its pages
and filled with illegible
scribbles. It's impossible
for you to decipher what
could be written inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一本
缺失了許多頁
且寫滿無法辨認
塗鴉的日記本。
你無法破譯
裡面可能寫的內容。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find what appears to
be somebody's research
journal. It's best not to
touch it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一本看起來像是某人的研究日記。現在最好不要碰它。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright, we need
to talk for a second
about this assignment.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧，我們需要就這個任務談一談。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Waaa-!
You came out
of nowhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇啊——！
你從哪冒出來的！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Sorry for scaring you.
We don't have time, so I'll
get straight to the point.
I don't trust our client.
However, for the time being,
we should do what he says.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
抱歉嚇到你了。
沒時間了，我直入正題。
我不信任我們的委託人。
不過，目前我們還是應該照他說的做。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
In the meantime, keep
an eye out. If you find
anything that might suggest
that Mr. R isn't telling us the
truth for some reason, let
me know. I'll see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
在此期間，保持警惕。
如果你發現任何跡象表明
R先生因為某種原因
沒有對我們說實話，
請告訴我。回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hey, I gotta talk to you
real quick without Mr. R
overhearing... I'm not
taking any chances with him!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嘿，我得在你和R先生
聽到之前快速說幾句...
我不想在他身上冒任何風險！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I tried to visit our local
historian to learn more about
Mr. R's research. To do that,
I left Mr. R alone for a little
while under our magic security system. However, I kinda failed.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我試圖拜訪當地的歷史學家，
以瞭解更多關於R先生研究的資訊。
為此，我在我們的魔法安保系統下
讓R先生獨自待了一會兒。然而，我有點失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I got a little peeved at
the historian guy, and he
got a little intimidated. Now
he's holed up somewhere
in the Morocc Inn, and I don't
think he's seeing anybody.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我對那個歷史學家有點生氣，
他也變得有點害怕了。現在他躲在
夢羅克旅館的某個地方，
我想他不見任何人。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
I want you to find Morocc's
historian and find out what
you can about Satan Morocc,
Morocc, and Thanatos Tower.
We need to know how they're
linked to the missing kids.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想讓你找到夢羅克的歷史學家，
並儘可能多地瞭解魔王夢羅克、
夢羅克和達納托斯塔。
我們需要知道他們與失蹤兒童
之間有什麼聯絡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess since he hasn't
met me yet, maybe he'll
talk to me. Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想既然他還沒見過我，
也許他會跟我說話。好吧，我會去做的。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Great, thanks a lot.
Okay then, I'll see
you later. Remember,
the Morocc Inn, alright?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
太好了，非常感謝。
那麼，回頭見。
記住，是夢羅克旅館，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
L-Lin...?
You there?

[Lin]
Yeah, I'm here.
So, were you able
to find that historian?
What exactly did you learn?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
是的，我在。
那麼，你找到那個歷史學家了嗎？
你具體學到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was only able to
speak to the historian's
assistant. Let's see...
I found out about the
origin of this city's name...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我只能與歷史學家的助手對話。
讓我看看...
我瞭解了這座城市名稱的起源...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanatos Tower was used
by Morocc Satan to summon
his own monsters into our
world. Now, it's being rebuilt,
even though it houses these
demons that look like angels...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
達納托斯塔曾被魔王夢羅克用來
召喚他自己的魔物進入我們的世界。
現在，它正在被重建，
儘管它裡面住著這些看起來像天使的惡魔...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Huh. That's strange.
I heard that those are
actually real angels that
are guarding the tower for
some reason. Hm. What else
did you manage to learn?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯。這很奇怪。
我聽說那些實際上是真正的天使，
出於某種原因守護著這座塔。嗯。你還
學到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, Satan Morocc, if it
exists, might be able to
come back into our world
if the seal is broken by
sacrificing children...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，魔王夢羅克，如果它存在的話，
可能會通過獻祭兒童來打破封印，
從而回到我們的世界...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
That... That sounds
really bad, especially
with all of those children
missing from Morocc lately.
What'll be our next move?
I guess we'll talk to Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
那...那聽起來真的很糟糕，尤其是
最近夢羅克有很多兒童失蹤。
我們下一步該怎麼做？
我想我們會和R先生談談。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
The way things are going,
he's probably gonna ask us
to investigate Thanatos Tower.
For now, we'll see what he wants. Ah, and not a word of anything
that we've discussed out here.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
按照目前的情況，
他可能會要求我們調查達納托斯塔。
目前，我們先看看他想要什麼。啊，還有，
不要把我們在這裡討論的任何事情說出去。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Report to me first.
Did you learn anything
about Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
先向我彙報。
你瞭解到關於達納托斯塔的任何資訊嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I found some old log
entries about Satan Morocc.
They pretty much confirm that
Satan Morocc is real, and that
it's sealed under Morocc Castle.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我找到了一些關於
魔王夢羅克的舊日誌。
它們基本上證實了魔王夢羅克
是真實存在的，而且
它被封印在夢羅克城堡下方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Rekenber Corporation
is also responsible for the
tower's reconstruction, and
they ultimately plan to repair
all tweleve of its levels.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雷肯貝爾公司也負責中央塔的
重建工作，他們最終計劃
修復塔的全部十二層。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Why would they want to do
something crazy like that?
If Mr. R is really preventing
Morocc Satan's return, then
his attackers must want
to revive Morocc Satan...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
他們為什麼要做
這麼瘋狂的事？
如果R先生真的在阻止
魔王夢羅克的迴歸，
那麼攻擊他的人一定
是想復活魔王夢羅克...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
But if he's lying, and
he's trying to bring Morocc
Satan into our world, then
he's wanted by the Dandelion
group... meaning, he may be
the target for Kidd's mission.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
但如果他在撒謊，
試圖把魔王夢羅克
帶到我們的世界，
那麼他就是蒲公英組織的
通緝犯...也就是說，
他可能是基德任務的目標。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Crap! This could be
really bad. I need to
talk about this to our
commanding officer Valdes
about this. While I do that,
you go and check on Mr. R.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
糟了！
情況可能非常嚴重。
我需要和瓦爾德斯指揮官
談談這件事。在我去之前，
你去看看R先生的情況。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Why did Valdes accept
both of these missions?!
In the worst case scenario,
we might be the ones who'll
have to keep Satan Morocc
from returning to this world...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
瓦爾德斯為什麼
接受了這兩個任務？！
在最壞的情況下，
我們可能不得不阻止
魔王夢羅克回到這個世界...

scripts.text:

crest that looks like a
splashing wave of water.^000000

to counter the crest's power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
飛濺的水波。^000000

some water which evaporated
quickly in mid-air: it seems
the Wind element neutralized
this crest's Water element.^000000

在空中迅速蒸發：
看來風元素
抵消了這枚徽章的水元素。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright...
Now I should look for
the crest hidden in the
field north of Morocc.

[{0}]
好吧...
現在我應該去
夢羅克北邊的田野
尋找隱藏的徽章。

scripts.text:

with the Mystic Frozen,
suddenly causing the air
to chill and raising the
waves in the oasis.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF徽章與水靈原石
產生共鳴，突然
空氣變得寒冷，
綠洲中的波浪也升了起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright...
Now I should look for
the crest hidden in the
field north of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...
現在我應該去
夢羅克北邊的田野
尋找隱藏的徽章。

^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
飛濺的水波。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. As you approach it,
you can feel the wind blowing
strongly against your skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
風的符號。當你靠近它時，
你能感覺到強風
吹拂著你的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be what
Raiyan Moore is so
interested in. Well,
I better go inform Kidd
about what I found here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這一定是
萊恩·摩爾非常感興趣的東西。
好吧，
我最好去告訴基德
我在這裡發現了什麼。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. As you approach it,
you can feel the wind blowing
strongly against your skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
風的符號。當你靠近它時，
你能感覺到強風
吹拂著你的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great, now that I found
this, I really need to tell
Kidd about it. Hopefully, he
found something just like this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了，既然我找到了
這個，我真的需要告訴
基德。希望
他也找到了類似的東西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. As you approach it,
you can feel the wind blowing
strongly against your skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
風的符號。當你靠近它時，
你能感覺到強風
吹拂著你的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, the power of the
Earth counteracts the 
Wind. I'll just pull out this
Great Nature and... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，土的力量
可以剋制風。
我只需拿出這塊
土靈原石...咦？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Wind elemental crest
quickly responds to the
Great Nature stone.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF風元素徽章
迅速對土靈原石
產生了反應。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Wind and Earth
neutralized each other,
causing the power of the
Wind in this area to stabilize.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF風與土相互抵消，
使得該區域的風之力
趨於穩定。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great, now that I'm done
with this crest, I need to
find the next one. Let's see,
I need to find the one to the
south that Kidd already found.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了，既然完成了這個徽章，
我需要找到下一個。
讓我想想，
我需要找到基德已經在南方找到的那個。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. As you approach it,
you can feel the wind blowing
strongly against your skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的
徽章，看起來像
風的符號。當你靠近它時，
你能感覺到強風
吹拂著你的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wind, wind, wind...
What do I use to counteract
the Wind property? It was...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
風，風，風...
我該用什麼來剋制
風屬性呢？是...

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解僱

scripts.text: Ice
scripts.translation: 冰

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fire...? No, that's...
Wind and Fire sort of
go together, don't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
火...？不，那是...
風和火
似乎是相生的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ice...? No...
The power of Wind, of
lightning, supersedes
the power of Ice and water...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冰...？不...
風和雷電的力量
凌駕於冰和水之上...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got it...!
I'll fight Wind
with Wind! No...
Don't be ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...！
我要以風克風！不對...
別開玩笑了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Earth...?
That's it! I need a
Great Nature to use
on this Wind crest!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
土...？
就是它！我需要一塊
土靈原石
來使用在這個風徽章上！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. However, you don't
think that it's particularly
worthy of an investigation.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的徽章，
看起來像風的符號。然而，
你覺得它並不值得
特別調查。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest
that looks like a symbol of
the Wind. However, the air
flow around it seems weak.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的徽章，
看起來像風的符號。然而，
它周圍的氣流似乎很微弱。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be what I'm looking
for. It looks like an artifact of the Wind element, but the wind
around here isn't as strong as it should be. I think I might need
to bring a ^4D4DFFRough Wind^000000 here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這應該就是我找的東西。
它看起來像風元素的遺物，
但這裡的風
不像應該那麼強。
我想我需要帶一塊 ^4D4DFF風靈原石^000000 來...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Hopefully this
Rough Wind will do
the trick. Whoa. Um...
Something's happening...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我看看...
希望這塊
風靈原石能起作用。
哇。嗯...
好像有什麼在發生...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe elemental crest
quickly responds to the
Rough Wind, causing the
crest to shine brighter and
the wind to blow stronger.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF元素徽章
迅速對風靈原石
產生了反應，
使得徽章更加明亮，
風也吹得更猛烈了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess that's that.
Now I need to talk to Lin
and figure out if there are
more of these things to be
found outside of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，這就結束了。
現在我需要去找琳，
弄清楚在莫洛奇之外
是否還有更多這樣的東西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to bring
a Rough Wind to activate
this Wind elemental crest.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你需要帶一塊
風靈原石來啟用
這個風元素徽章。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shining crest

scripts.translation:

徽章，看起來像
風的符號。當你靠近它時，
你能感覺到強風
吹拂著你的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a shimmering
crest that symbolizes
the power of the Earth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一枚閃閃發光的徽章，
象徵著土的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I should use this
Flame Heart to
stabilize this crest.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我看看...
我應該用這塊
火靈原石
來穩定這個徽章。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs soon as you pull out
the Flame Heart, the stone
and the crest begin to glow
intensely, as if their powers
were conflicting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你拿出
火靈原石的那一刻，
石頭和徽章開始
劇烈發光，
彷彿它們的力量
在相互衝突。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Flame Heart then
quickly vanishes with
a burst of heated vapor.
This power of this crest
is now stabilized.^000000
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Hopefully, I was able to
help you with whatever
information that you needed.
Morocc has a much richer
history than most people
realize, don't you think?

[塞菲特]
希望我能為你提供
所需的資訊。
莫洛奇的歷史
比大多數人想像的
要豐富得多，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Hopefully, I was able to
help you with whatever
information that you needed.
Morocc has a much richer
history than most people
realize, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
希望我能為你提供
所需的資訊。
莫洛奇的歷史
比大多數人想像的
要豐富得多，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
When I get some time,
I really want to investigate
that Thanatos Tower. I get
the feeling that there's so
much I can learn there~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
等我有空的時候，
真的很想去調查一下
達納托斯塔。
我感覺在那裡
能學到很多東西~

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, we usually don't
have many visitors here.
Are you here to speak to
our local historian? He's
pretty busy right now, so
I hope you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，我們這裡
通常很少有訪客。
你是來和我們的
當地歷史學家對話的嗎？
他現在很忙，
希望你能稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Though, to be honest,
he's kind of hiding under
the covers at the moment.
Some Assassin came to
request some information,
but he scared him off...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
不過說實話，
他此刻正躲在被子裡。
有個刺客來
請求獲取一些資訊，
但他把他嚇跑了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
It was pretty funny, actually.
The guy walked in, flashed
his dagger, and declared that
he needed some important
information. I guess my boss
was pretty intimidated by him.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
其實還挺好笑的。
那個人走進來，亮出短劍，
聲稱需要一些重要的資訊。
我想我的老闆被他嚇到了。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
If it's really important,
then I might be able to
answer your questions if
they're about Morocc's most
ancient histories and legends.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
如果真的很重要，
只要問題涉及夢羅克
最古老的歷史和傳說，
我或許能回答你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ask Sephit about the
four elemental crests around
Morocc, their significance, and
about Raiyan Moore. You also
inform her that you've already
stabilized the crests' power.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向塞菲特詢問
夢羅克周圍四枚元素紋章
及其意義，還有萊揚·摩爾。
你還告訴她，
你已經穩定了紋章的力量。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Moore... Moore...
His work sounds really
important, so I'm surprised
I haven't heard of him. I'd ask
my boss, but I can't disturb
him right now. Ah, well...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
摩爾...摩爾...
他的工作聽起來很重要，
所以我有點驚訝沒聽說過他。
我想問問老闆，
但現在不能打擾他。啊，算了...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Oh, first of all, not too
many people know about
those crests. Still, you did
a great service by stabilizing
them. Otherwise, the seal under
Morocc Castle would break.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
哦，首先，
知道那些紋章的人並不多。
不過，你穩定了它們，
真是幫了大忙。
否則，夢羅克城堡下方的
封印就會破裂。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
The seal beneath Morocc
Castle actually keeps Satan
Morocc from entering our world.
If he ever returned, he might
repeat the mass destruction
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
夢羅克城堡下方的封印
實際上是為了阻止魔王夢羅克
進入我們的世界。
如果他再次回來，
可能會重演大規模的破壞。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
When Satan Morocc
was terrorizing the human
world, he used Thanatos
Tower as his power base.
There, he would summon
countless hordes of minions.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
當魔王夢羅克
肆虐人間時，
他利用達納托斯塔
作為他的據點。
在那裡，他召喚出
無數的魔物大軍。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
That tower has been in ruins
for years, but recently some
company started reconstructing
it, even though demons, well,
disguised as angels, still
roam that place freely.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
那座塔已經荒廢多年，
但最近有家公司
開始重建它，
儘管惡魔們，呃，
偽裝成天使，
仍然在那兒自由遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Satan Morocc may have been
unimaginably powerful, but
it would take a lot of work
to bring him back into our
world. Let's see, you could
destroy Morocc's seal...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
魔王夢羅克可能強大得
超乎想像，
但要讓他回到我們的世界，
需要付出巨大的努力。
讓我想想，你可以
破壞夢羅克的封印...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
There was also... Oh, God.
Long ago, someone actually
sacrificed children in a failed
attempt to revive Morocc Satan.
The children missing here in
Morocc-- Y-you don't think...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
還有...哦，天哪。
很久以前，有人
為了復活魔王夢羅克
而獻祭了兒童。
夢羅克失蹤的兒童——
你...你不會覺得...

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
But who really knows?
I mean we have historical
records of Satan Morocc, 
but maybe it's just a legend.
Aside from that, we have no
proof that he really exists.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
但誰知道呢？
畢竟我們有魔王夢羅克的
歷史記錄，
但也許那只是傳說。
除此之外，
我們沒有證據證明他真實存在。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
...Well, aside from those
elemental crests, I mean.
Then again, maybe they just
regulate this region's elements
to make it possible for people
to live here in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
...好吧，除了那些
元素紋章之外。
不過話說回來，
也許它們只是調節
這個地區的元素，
讓人們能在沙漠中生存。

learned something about
a monster called Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
最近，我翻閱了一些
古老的歷史記錄，
瞭解到了一個
名叫魔王夢羅克的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
According to the legends,
he's sealed beneath Morocc
Castle, and our town gets its
name from him. That sounds
pretty grotesque, don't you
think? Too weird to be true...
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
根據傳說，
他被封印在夢羅克城堡下方，
我們的城鎮
就是以他命名的。
聽起來挺可怕的，
你覺得呢？太離奇了，
不像是真的...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
That's grave news...
I had my suspicions
about Mr. R, but I never
thought he was capable
of such audacity...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
真是嚴重的訊息...
我對R先生有所懷疑，
但沒想到他竟敢如此大膽...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn it! I know you had
to accept both Mr. R and
the Dandelion Organization
because we didn't know the
truth beforehand, but does
Lin know about this now?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
該死！我知道你不得不同時接受R先生和蒲公英組織，
因為我們事先並不知道真相，
但現在琳知道這件事了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I doubt it. I only learned
that Mr. R was the true
kidnapper when you told
me just now. But to sacrifice
them in order to revive Satan
Morocc... That's beyond evil.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
我想不會。直到你剛才告訴我，
我才得知R先生才是真正的綁架者。
但為了復活魔王夢羅克而犧牲他們...
這簡直邪惡至極。

scripts.text:

Moore, then you can find him
in the other room. Go and
interrogate him, confirm
everything you have learned.
scripts.translation:
