那麼你可以在隔壁房間找到他。
去審問他，確認你所知道的一切。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Come...
This way.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
來...
這邊請。

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
This is getting
too serious. Valdes,
wait, I'm coming with you!
{0}, come on, quickly!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
情況越來越嚴重了。瓦爾德斯，
等等，我和你一起去！
{0}，快跟上！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Master, did you know
from the beginning?!
You knew that the person
I was supposed to protect
is the same person that
Kidd is supposed to find?!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
師父，你一開始就知道了嗎？！
你早就知道我要保護的人，
就是基德要尋找的那個人？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Lin, calm down. Yes,
I suspected as such from
the start. However, I did
know whether to trust Mr. R
or the Dandelion organization.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
琳，冷靜點。是的，
我一開始就有所懷疑。但是，
我並不知道該信任R先生
還是蒲公英組織。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Since both parties claimed
to be able to help the missing
children, I took the chance.
For now, the best thing to
do would be to ask if Mr. R's
attackers are from Dandelion...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
既然雙方都聲稱能幫到失蹤的兒童，
我就賭了一把。
眼下最好的辦法，
就是問問襲擊R先生的人是否來自蒲公英...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Alright... I can't believe
it... Mr. R. Moore... Kidd
is supposed to hunt down
Raiyan Moore... It's too
much of a coincidence...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
好吧...我簡直不敢相信...
R. 摩爾...基德本該追捕萊恩·摩爾...
這也太巧了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lin! I'm sorry to
interrupt, but Mr. R
is missing... I don't
know where he is!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
琳！抱歉打擾一下，
但R先生不見了...我不知道他在哪裡！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What?! What do yo--
Wh-what's going on?!
What's this noise in
my f-freakin' head?!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼？！你剛說什--
發...發生什麼事了？！
我頭...我腦子裡這是什麼聲音？！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh no...
This is what
I feared the most...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
糟糕...
這正是我最害怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's...
What's going on?

[Lin]
I think...
I think it's the
ceremony to revive
Satan Morocc! Mr. R must
have went there to stop
them... or to join them!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
我想...
我想那是復活魔王夢羅克的儀式！
R先生一定是去阻止他們了...
或者是去加入他們了！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Lin, go call everyone
in the guild! And you,
try to find the source
of that weird echo!
Hurry, there's no time!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
琳，去叫公會裡的所有人！
還有你，
試著找出那奇怪回聲的來源！
快一點，沒時間了！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
遵命，師父！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
No matter what the 
cost, we can't let
that ritual finish...!
If Satan Morocc really
exists, we can't let
him enter our world!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
無論付出什麼代價，
我們都不能讓那個儀式完成...！
如果魔王夢羅克真的存在，
我們不能讓他進入我們的世界！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?! That sounds
like Lin's voice...
Where are they?
Where have they gone?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？！那聽起來
像是琳的聲音...
他們在哪裡？
他們去了哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Raiyan Moore...!
Wh-where is he?!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
萊恩·摩爾...！
他...他在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
What the deuce?
He should be just
in this room. Wait,
how could he get past
our security magic...?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
該死？
他應該就在這間房間裡。等等，
他是怎麼繞過我們的防護魔法的...？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Where's Lin?
Lin?! Lin, where
are you? Answer me!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
琳在哪裡？
琳？！琳，你在哪？回答我！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
God! Wh-what's
that--where is that
voice coming from?!
My head feels like
it's gonna split open!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
天哪！那...那是什麼——
那個聲音是從哪裡傳來的？！
我的頭感覺快要炸開了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...
What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼...
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Damn, that has to be him!
He's trying to revive Satan
Morocc right now! And where's
Lin?! What happened to her?
scripts.translation:
[基德]
該死，那一定是他！
他正在試圖復活魔王夢羅克！琳呢？！
她怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
{0}, I'm going
to call every member of the
Assassin Guild. You and Kidd
go try to find the source of
that voice and stop this!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
{0}，我要去召集刺客公會的所有成員。
你和基德去找那個聲音的來源，阻止這一切！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
遵命，師父！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I only hope that
we're not too late
to stop this from
happening. Hurry,
the fate of the world
hangs in the balance!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
我只希望我們來得及阻止這一切。
快一點，世界的命運懸於一線！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the body
of a dead man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一具死去的男子的屍體。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying
on the floor. He seems
very close to dying, and
is mumbling deliriously.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現一名男子躺在地上。他似乎奄奄一息，
正胡言亂語。^000000

scripts.text:
[Man]
Ghhhk~! Fr-fresh...
B-blood! Hee hee hee~
For th-the ritual, I-I'll
d-dedicate... Myself...
For the s-sacrifice!
^333333*Cough Cough!*^000000

[Man]
Ghhhk~! Fr-fresh...
B-blood! Hee hee hee~
For th-the ritual, I-I'll
d-dedicate... Myself...
For the s-sacrifice!
^333333*Cough Cough!*^000000

^3355FFYou will now be
teleported outside.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你即將被傳送到外面。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Holy... ritual... of...
blood... I am proud...
to b-be... the last...
sacrifice... Heh heh heh...^000000

^3355FFThe maniacal laughter
from that strange voice
echoes in your head as you
wake up in some strange place.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那個奇怪聲音的狂笑在你腦海中迴盪，
當你醒來時，發現自己身處一個陌生的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
What is this place?
Arrgh, my head hurts,
but I've got to stop
Satan Morocc's revival...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡...？
這是什麼地方？
啊，頭好痛，
但我必須阻止魔王夢羅克的復活...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's that voice
again! Kidd? Valdes?
Are any of you here?
Damn, I must be all alone.
I guess I have to stop this
weird ritual all by myself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是那個聲音！基德？瓦爾德斯？
你們在這裡嗎？
該死，我一定是孤身一人。
看來我得獨自阻止這個奇怪的儀式了！

scripts.text:
[?????]
...Isn't the moon
so beautiful tonight?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...今晚的月亮真美啊？

scripts.text:
[?????]
...But I wonder...
Why are there twice as many
guards when the moon is full?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...不過我想知道...
為什麼滿月的時候，衛兵的數量會多一倍？

scripts.text:
[???????]
The moon is so red...
Yes, it's been a year...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
月亮好紅...
是的，已經一年了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's going on?
Who's there? Kidd?
Valdes? Anybody?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？
誰在那裡？基德？
瓦爾德斯？有人嗎？
剛才那是什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
[?????]
So, you telling me you
don't know how this town
got its name? Well, it's
kind of a scary tale...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
這麼說，你不知道
這座城鎮名字的由來？
嗯，這其實是個
有點可怕的故事...

scripts.text:
[?????]
An evil demon invaded our
world, summoning troops of
his minions from the darkness.
However, he was defeated and
sealed beneath this castle
by a legendary hero.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
一個邪惡的惡魔入侵了
我們的世界，從黑暗中
召喚出他的爪牙大軍。
然而，他被一位傳奇英雄
擊敗，並封印在這座城堡之下。

scripts.text:
[???????]
But the hatred of Satan
Morocc has not ebbed with
time. If you look at the full
moon from here, it is colored
red with Satan Morocc's rage...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
但魔王夢羅克的仇恨
並沒有隨時間消退。
如果你從這裡看滿月，
會發現它被魔王夢羅克的
怒火染成了紅色...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I keep hearing
things! Where the hell
is it all coming from?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我不斷聽到
聲音！這該死的
聲音到底是從哪裡來的？！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hmpf.
It has begun.

[?????]
That smoke...?
What exactly is going
on over there every
full moon?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
那煙霧...？
每到滿月，那邊到底
在發生什麼事？

scripts.text:
[???????]
Well...
Who's to say?

[{0}]
These voices...
They're like past
memories of something
that's happened here
in Castle Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些聲音...
它們像是這裡發生過的
某些事情的
過去記憶...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sir, our investigation has
turned something up. Every
15 days, a carriage secretly
transports about 20 to 30
children into the castle.
However, they never come out...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
大人，我們的調查
有了發現。每隔15天，
就有馬車秘密運送
20到30名兒童進入城堡。
然而，他們從未出來過...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Are you serious...?
What the hell could
they be doing in there?!
Come on, let's go...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
你是認真的...？
他們到底在裡面做什麼？！
快，我們走...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Wh-what's with
all of this noise?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
這...這些噪音
是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sorry, m'lord.
It's nothing, but
we'll take care of
it as soon as possible.
Shut up, children. Silence!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
抱歉，大人。
沒什麼大事，
我們會盡快處理。
閉嘴，孩子們。安靜！

scripts.text:
[???????]
This place is so hot...
Where's my daddy? I don't...
I don't wanna go to Thanatos...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
這裡好熱...
爸爸在哪裡？我不想...
我不想去塔納托斯...

scripts.text:
[??????]
Make sure that
nothing interferes
with our plan. Nothing...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
確保沒有任何東西
干擾我們的計劃。什麼都沒有...

scripts.text:
[????]
I don't wanna
wear these chains!
G-get them off, please!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm s--
scripts.translation:
[????]
我不想
戴這些鎖鏈！
請...請把它們拿掉！
對不起，對不起，對不...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't...
I can't endure
listening to this
much longer. Where
the hell is Raiyan Moore?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受不了了...
我不能再
聽下去了。雷伊安·摩爾
到底在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Jeez, what's going
on? Where the heck
are all the guards?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
天哪，發生什麼事了？
衛兵們到底都去哪了？

scripts.text:
[????]
What?! Why would
anyone do something
so stupid, so foolhardy,
as revive Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
什麼？！為什麼會有人
做出如此愚蠢、如此魯莽的事，
比如復活魔王夢羅克？！

scripts.text:
[????]
Why...?
You can't possibly
understand. Now die...!
scripts.translation:
[????]
為什麼...？
你不可能理解的。
現在去死吧...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is that voice
coming from? Wait...
That's... That's happening
right now! Please... Please
don't let me be too late!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個聲音是從哪裡傳來的？等等...
那是...那是正在發生的事！請...請
別讓我來晚了！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hey... Are
you alright?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
嘿...你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks...
I think you just
saved my life. What's
going on? Are you alone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝...
我想你剛才救了我的命。發生什麼事了？你一個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
It took me a while, but
I gathered as many members
of Dandelion as I could. From
the looks of it, I wouldn't be
surprised if Satan Morocc was
almost unsealed by now...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
花了一些時間，但我召集了儘可能多的蒲公英成員。
從情況看來，魔王夢羅克可能馬上就要被解封了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
What about Kidd?
Where did he go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
基德呢？
他去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Kidd? He already
went in before any
of us. It sounds pretty
dangerous in there...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
基德？他比我們都早進去了。裡面聽起來很危險...

scripts.text:
[Kidd's Voice]
...I said--!
...That's...
Why I oughta--!
scripts.translation:
[基德的聲音]
...我說--！
...那是...
為什麼我要--！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Yeah, that's him again.
Now that you're awake,
I better do something.
You stay here and gather
your strength while I go
in there and help him...
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
對，又是他。
既然你醒了，
我得做點什麼。
你在這裡休息恢復體力，我去裡面幫他...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, what's going
on here? Kidd! Lin?
A-and who's that guy?
Could it possibly be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，這裡發生什麼事了？基德！琳？
還有...那個人是誰？
難道會是...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
{0}...
Stay back and don't come
near me! Lin, why are you
doing this! Give up your
mission, you don't know
who your client really is!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
{0}...
退後，別靠近我！琳，你為什麼要這樣做！放棄你的任務，你不知道你的委託人到底是誰！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What are you talking
about, Kidd? I just found
out that the people you're
working for, the Dandelion
Organization, have been
hunting Mr. Moore down...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
你在說什麼，基德？我剛剛發現，你為之工作的人，蒲公英組織，一直在追捕摩爾先生...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yes, of course they're
hunting him down. Your client,
Mr. R. Moore, is none other
than Raiyan Moore-- and he
plans to revive Satan Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是的，當然他們在追捕他。你的委託人，R. 摩爾，正是雷伊安·摩爾--而他打算復活魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What?! But how can that
be? I've been with Moore
for a few days! If he's the one
who kidnapped the children,
then who is taking them hostage?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼？！但這怎麼可能？我和摩爾先生在一起好幾天了！如果他是綁架孩子的人，那麼是誰在挾持他們？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
No, you should tell
me everything you know
about your own client,
the Dandelion Organization...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
不，你應該告訴我你所知道的一切，關於你的委託人，蒲公英組織...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Thanks for your
concern, Lin. But really...
It's unnecessary. Heh heh...
I don't need to worry about the Dandelion Organization any longer.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
謝謝你的關心，琳。但真的...
沒必要。嘿嘿...
我不再需要擔心蒲公英組織了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Prepare yourself
and be accepted into
this sacrifice... Lin...
Your blood will be used
to revive Morocc Satan!
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
做好準備，接受這個犧牲吧...琳...
你的血將被用來復活魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
小心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kidd! Lin!

[Lin]
Wh-why...?
Mr. Moore, you said
that you were trying to
stop Satan Morocc's revival...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
為...為什麼...？
摩爾先生，你明明說過
要阻止魔王夢羅克的復活...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Can't you see...?
He was lying! He
tricked all of us!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你難道看不出來嗎...？
他在撒謊！他欺騙了
我們所有人！

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
So...
You're resisting?
Fine, you leave me
no choice. Feel the
power of Morocc Satan!
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
是嗎...
你們在反抗嗎？
很好，既然這樣，
我就別無選擇了。感受
魔王夢羅克的力量吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bastard, what
are you doing?
Holy crap, m-monsters!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
混蛋，你在幹什麼？
天哪，魔...魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Damn it!
Let me go!
I'm gonna chase
Moore myself!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
該死！
放開我！
我要親自去追摩爾！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
{0}!
Hey, you alright?
Come on, let's head
back, the other members
of the Assassin Guild
will take care of this...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
{0}！
嘿，你沒事吧？
快，我們回去吧，
刺客公會的其他成員
會處理這裡的...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou will now be
teleported outside.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你即將被傳送到外面。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Holy... ritual... of...
blood... I am proud...
to b-be... the last...
sacrifice... Heh heh heh...^000000

^3355FFThe maniacal laughter
from that strange voice
echoes in your head as you
wake up in some strange place.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那個奇怪聲音的狂笑在你腦海中迴盪，
當你醒來時，發現自己身處一個陌生的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
What is this place?
Arrgh, my head hurts,
but I've got to stop
Satan Morocc's revival...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡...？
這是什麼地方？
啊，頭好痛，
但我必須阻止魔王夢羅克的復活...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's that voice
again! Kidd? Valdes?
Are any of you here?
Damn, I must be all alone.
I guess I have to stop this
weird ritual all by myself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是那個聲音！基德？瓦爾德斯？
你們在這裡嗎？
該死，我一定是孤身一人。
看來我得獨自阻止這個奇怪的儀式了！

scripts.text:
[?????]
...Isn't the moon
so beautiful tonight?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...今晚的月亮真美啊？

scripts.text:
[?????]
...But I wonder...
Why are there twice as many
guards when the moon is full?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
...不過我想知道...
為什麼滿月的時候，衛兵的數量會多一倍？

scripts.text:
[???????]
The moon is so red...
Yes, it's been a year...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
月亮好紅...
是的，已經一年了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's going on?
Who's there? Kidd?
Valdes? Anybody?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？
誰在那裡？基德？
瓦爾德斯？有人嗎？
剛才那是什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
[?????]
So, you telling me you
don't know how this town
got its name? Well, it's
kind of a scary tale...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
這麼說，你不知道
這座城鎮名字的由來？
嗯，這其實是個
有點可怕的故事...

scripts.text:
[?????]
An evil demon invaded our
world, summoning troops of
his minions from the darkness.
However, he was defeated and
sealed beneath this castle
by a legendary hero.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
一個邪惡的惡魔入侵了
我們的世界，從黑暗中
召喚出他的爪牙大軍。
然而，他被一位傳奇英雄
擊敗，並封印在這座城堡之下。

scripts.text:
[???????]
But the hatred of Satan
Morocc has not ebbed with
time. If you look at the full
moon from here, it is colored
red with Satan Morocc's rage...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
但魔王夢羅克的仇恨
並沒有隨時間消退。
如果你從這裡看滿月，
會發現它被魔王夢羅克的
怒火染成了紅色...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I keep hearing
things! Where the hell
is it all coming from?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我不斷聽到
聲音！這該死的
聲音到底是從哪裡來的？！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hmpf.
It has begun.

[?????]
That smoke...?
What exactly is going
on over there every
full moon?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
那煙霧...？
每到滿月，那邊到底
在發生什麼事？

scripts.text:
[???????]
Well...
Who's to say?

[{0}]
These voices...
They're like past
memories of something
that's happened here
in Castle Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些聲音...
它們像是這裡發生過的
某些事情的
過去記憶...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sir, our investigation has
turned something up. Every
15 days, a carriage secretly
transports about 20 to 30
children into the castle.
However, they never come out...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
大人，我們的調查
有了發現。每隔15天，
就有馬車秘密運送
20到30名兒童進入城堡。
然而，他們從未出來過...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Are you serious...?
What the hell could
they be doing in there?!
Come on, let's go...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
你是認真的...？
他們到底在裡面做什麼？！
快，我們走...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Wh-what's with
all of this noise?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
這...這些噪音
是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sorry, m'lord.
It's nothing, but
we'll take care of
it as soon as possible.
Shut up, children. Silence!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
抱歉，大人。
沒什麼大事，
我們會盡快處理。
閉嘴，孩子們。安靜！

scripts.text:
[???????]
This place is so hot...
Where's my daddy? I don't...
I don't wanna go to Thanatos...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
這裡好熱...
爸爸在哪裡？我不想...
我不想去塔納托斯...

scripts.text:
[??????]
Make sure that
nothing interferes
with our plan. Nothing...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
確保沒有任何東西
干擾我們的計劃。什麼都沒有...

scripts.text:
[????]
I don't wanna
wear these chains!
G-get them off, please!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm s--
scripts.translation:
[????]
我不想
戴這些鎖鏈！
請...請把它們拿掉！
對不起，對不起，對不...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't...
I can't endure
listening to this
much longer. Where
the hell is Raiyan Moore?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受不了了...
我不能再
聽下去了。雷伊安·摩爾
到底在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Jeez, what's going
on? Where the heck
are all the guards?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
天哪，發生什麼事了？
衛兵們到底都去哪了？

scripts.text:
[????]
What?! Why would
anyone do something
so stupid, so foolhardy,
as revive Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
什麼？！為什麼會有人
做出如此愚蠢、如此魯莽的事，
比如復活魔王夢羅克？！

scripts.text:
[????]
Why...?
You can't possibly
understand. Now die...!
scripts.translation:
[????]
為什麼...？
你不可能理解的。
現在去死吧...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is that voice
coming from? Wait...
That's... That's happening
right now! Please... Please
don't let me be too late!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個聲音是從哪裡傳來的？等等...
那是...那是正在發生的事！請...請
別讓我來晚了！

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Hey, are you alright?
That was a pretty huge
explosion just now!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
嘿，你沒事吧？
剛才那爆炸聲
可真夠大的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. R...?
Oh. You're not him.
Thanks, I think you
just saved my life. Hey...
Have you seen a female
Assassin around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
R...先生？
哦。原來不是你。
謝謝，我想你
剛才救了我的命。嘿...
你在這附近見過
女刺客嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
No, I don't think
so, but there's another
Assassin, Kidd, who's just
in the area. Wait, were you the
one who was duped by Raiyan
Moore? He's your client, right?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
沒有，我不覺得
見過，不過這裡還有
另一個刺客，基德，
他就在附近。等等，你是
那個被萊恩·摩爾騙了的人嗎？
他是你的委託人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
I'm a member of the
Dandelion Organization,
and we've been trying to find
him. It turns out that we were
right about Moore: he's really planning to revive Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
我是蒲公英組織的
成員，我們一直在尋找他。
事實證明，我們對摩爾的
判斷是對的：他確實
在策劃復活魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? What are you
talking about? Wait,
Raiyan Moore? Do you
mean Mr. R. Moore?
No! Then this means...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？你在說什麼？
等等，萊恩·摩爾？
你是說R. 摩爾先生？
不！那這意味著...

scripts.text:
[Dandelion Member]
Right. He managed to
trick all of us. Now, if you'd
excuse me, I better go help
Kidd now that you're awake.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英成員]
沒錯。他成功欺騙了
我們所有人。好了，
既然你醒了，
我得去幫基德了。

scripts.text:
[Lin's Voice]
...S-stop...
...This is...
This is all insane!
scripts.translation:
[琳的聲音]
...停...下...
...這是...
這太瘋狂了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's... That's Lin's
voice! I better walk
through this darkness
and try to find her as
soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是...那是琳的
聲音！我得穿過這片
黑暗，儘快找到她！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, what's going
on here? Kidd! Lin?
A-and who's that guy?
Could it possibly be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，這裡發生什麼事了？基德！琳？
還有...那個人是誰？
難道會是...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
{0}...
Stay back and don't come
near me! Lin, why are you
doing this! Give up your
mission, you don't know
who your client really is!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
{0}...
退後，別靠近我！琳，你為什麼要這樣做！放棄你的任務，你不知道你的委託人到底是誰！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What are you talking
about, Kidd? I just found
out that the people you're
working for, the Dandelion
Organization, have been
hunting Mr. Moore down...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
你在說什麼，基德？我剛剛發現，你為之工作的人，蒲公英組織，一直在追捕摩爾先生...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Yes, of course they're
hunting him down. Your client,
Mr. R. Moore, is none other
than Raiyan Moore-- and he
plans to revive Satan Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
是的，當然他們在追捕他。你的委託人，R. 摩爾，正是雷伊安·摩爾--而他打算復活魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
What?! But how can that
be? I've been with Moore
for a few days! If he's the one
who kidnapped the children,
then who is taking them hostage?
scripts.translation:
[琳]
什麼？！但這怎麼可能？我和摩爾先生在一起好幾天了！如果他是綁架孩子的人，那麼是誰在挾持他們？

scripts.text:
[Lin]
No, you should tell
me everything you know
about your own client,
the Dandelion Organization...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
不，你應該告訴我你所知道的一切，關於你的委託人，蒲公英組織...

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Thanks for your
concern, Lin. But really...
It's unnecessary. Heh heh...
I don't need to worry about the Dandelion Organization any longer.
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
謝謝你的關心，琳。但真的...
沒必要。嘿嘿...
我不再需要擔心蒲公英組織了。

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
Prepare yourself
and be accepted into
this sacrifice... Lin...
Your blood will be used
to revive Morocc Satan!
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
做好準備，接受這個犧牲吧...琳...
你的血將被用來復活魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
小心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kidd! Lin!

[Lin]
Wh-why...?
Mr. Moore, you said
that you were trying to
stop Satan Morocc's revival...
scripts.translation:
[琳]
為...為什麼...？
摩爾先生，你明明說過
要阻止魔王夢羅克的復活...

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
Can't you see...?
He was lying! He
tricked all of us!
scripts.translation:
[基德]
你難道看不出來嗎...？
他在撒謊！他欺騙了
我們所有人！

scripts.text:
[R. Moore]
So...
You're resisting?
Fine, you leave me
no choice. Feel the
power of Morocc Satan!
scripts.translation:
[R. 摩爾]
是嗎...
你們在反抗嗎？
很好，既然這樣，
我就別無選擇了。感受
魔王夢羅克的力量吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bastard, what
are you doing?
Holy crap, m-monsters!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
混蛋，你在幹什麼？
天哪，魔...魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Damn it!
Let me go!
I'm gonna chase
Moore myself!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
該死！
放開我！
我要親自去追摩爾！

scripts.text:
[Kidd]
{0}...!
Can you hear me? Oh man...
You don't look so hot. Come
on, we gotta get you back
to the guild for now...
scripts.translation:
[基德]
{0}...！
你能聽到我嗎？天哪...
你看起來不太好。快，
我們得先把你帶回公會...

scripts.text:
[Chairman]
So it's agreed.
Tomorrow we'll clean
the pond near the south
gate tomorrow. I hope
that everyone can make it.
scripts.translation:
[會長]
那就這麼定了。
明天我們要清理
南門外池塘的垃圾。
希望大家都能參加。

scripts.text:
[Members]
Sure, no problem.
When are we planning
on reconstructing the
daycare facilities?
scripts.translation:
[成員]
沒問題。
我們計劃什麼時候
重建托兒所設施？

scripts.text:
[Chairman]
Hmmm...
I guess that's an
issue that we can
save for tomorrow's
meeting. I'll see you then.
scripts.translation:
[會長]
嗯...
我想這個問題
可以留到明天的
會議上討論。到時候見。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this some
sort of volunteer
service group?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是什麼
志願者服務團體嗎？

scripts.text:
[?????]
...That's what
happened... Worked
hard... This time...

[???]
There is just one
regret... Was that...
...tan... was... better...

[????????]
I know, I know that!
But we still accomplished
what we set out to do, right?
scripts.translation:
[????????]
我知道，我當然知道！
但我們還是完成了
當初定下的目標，對吧？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Quiet!
You're too loud.

[?????]
I'm pretty sure...
...is... not going to
be quiet about this.
Perhaps... it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
我敢肯定...
...不會...
就此安靜的。
也許... 會發生吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
Shh. Act naturally!
Someone's listening
to us! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[???]
噓。表現得自然點！
有人在偷聽我們！
快離開這裡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this some
sort of volunteer
service group?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是什麼
志願者服務團體嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
...No. How many
times must I tell you?
I'm not going back.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
...不。我要說多少遍？
我不會回去的。

scripts.text:
[Kimmie]
Please...
We really need
you back home...
scripts.translation:
[金米]
求你了...
我們真的需要你
回家...

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I'm sorry, Kimmie.
I have to follow my
own path. You'll have
to make do without me.
Besides, you're strong
and don't really need me...
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
對不起，金米。
我必須走自己的路。
你們只能沒有我
繼續生活了。
況且，你很堅強，
其實並不需要我...

scripts.text:
[Kimmie]
Y-you can't do this!
Why did you leave us?
I d-didn't want to tell you
this, but Jimmy's been getting
in trouble with the law and...
scripts.translation:
[金米]
你...你不能這樣！
你為什麼要離開我們？
我...我不想告訴你，
但是吉米最近總是惹上
法律麻煩，而且...

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Then it's his own
fault. I don't care, I'm
still not going home...
I've got to be responsible
for myself before I can even
think of taking care of others.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那是他自己的錯。
我不在乎，我還是
不會回家...
在能照顧別人之前，
我得先對自己負責。

scripts.text:
[Kimmie]
Shut up! Shut up!
Come back to us!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
閉嘴！閉嘴！
回來吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea what's
going on, but it seems
pretty bad. Sometimes it's
good not to get involved
with other people's problems.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全不知道發生了
什麼事，但看起來
很糟糕。有時候，
不捲入別人的麻煩
是件好事。

scripts.text:
A total of {0} users completed
the Satan Morocc: Lin Quest.
There are 2 requirements to
summon Satan Morocc's troops.
1) 50 users must complete
this Satan Morocc: Lin Quest.
scripts.translation:
共有 {0} 名使用者完成了
魔王夢羅克：琳 任務。
召喚魔王夢羅克的軍隊
需要滿足2個條件。
1) 50名使用者必須完成
這個魔王夢羅克：琳 任務。

scripts.text:
2) One of these users that
completed the Lin Quest must
approach the Dandelion Org
NPCs at the outskirts of Morocc to trigger the monster invasion.
Change the GlobalVar to affect status of Satan Morocc invasion?
scripts.translation:
2) 完成琳任務的使用者中，
必須有一人前往夢羅克郊外的
蒲公英組織NPC處，
以觸發怪物入侵。
修改全域性變數以影響
魔王夢羅克入侵的狀態？

scripts.text: Set Globalvar
scripts.translation: 設定全域性變數

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
Please choose the number
of times that the Lin Quest
will be recorded as completed
on the server. 0 is essentially
a reset; 50 will immediately
make the invasion available.
scripts.translation:
請選擇琳任務在伺服器上
被記錄完成的次數。
0 基本上等同於重置；
50 將立即使入侵可用。

scripts.text:
The GlobalVar has been
set to 49. The Lin Quest
must be completed 1 more
time before the Satan Morocc
invasion can be triggered.
scripts.translation:
全域性變數已設定為 49。
琳任務還需要完成 1 次，
才能觸發魔王夢羅克入侵。

scripts.text:
The GlobalVar has been
set to 50. The Satan Morocc
invasion can now be triggered.
scripts.translation:
全域性變數已設定為 50。
現在可以觸發魔王夢羅克入侵了。

scripts.text:
